jobs.title: Chef- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

jobs.title: Welder, Lohja

Wellpack is looking for a skilled welder for our client company in Lohja to manufacture demanding industrial products. The client is a long-established Finnish technology industry company that manufactures demanding products and assemblies for industrial applications. Its production is characterized by high quality, strong technical expertise, and the processing of demanding materials.

What is the work like?

As a welder, your work will focus on demanding manual welding in a production environment. The products, materials, and material thicknesses vary, offering diverse tasks for an experienced welder. The work mainly involves acid-resistant and stainless steels, including duplex and super duplex materials. In addition, you will weld carbon steel and various combinations of materials.

The work is carried out in one shift 40 hours per week from Monday to Friday, with the possibility of moving to a two-shift system. Depending on production needs, there may also be opportunities to work longer days and weekends. The position will start as soon as possible, according to agreement.

We expect you to have

* Strong previous experience in welding

* Experience in welding acid-resistant and stainless steels

* Ability to work with different materials and material thicknesses

* A precise and quality-oriented approach to work

* Valid Occupational Safety Card and Hot Work Card

* Good Finnish or English language skills

* Valid FW, PB, T+P, and FM5 qualifications, as well as FM1 qualification for carbon steel

The following are considered an advantage

* BW, PA, T, and FM5 qualifications

We offer you

* Full-time work in demanding industrial welding tasks

* Varied welding tasks involving different materials and heavy components

* The opportunity to use and develop your welding skills

* Support from a skilled and experienced work community

* The possibility of additional hours and weekend work depending on production needs

* Assistance with arranging accommodation, if needed

* Competitive salary

jobs.title: Production Worker (Day/night)
jobs.description:
Would you like to help ensure a more sustainable future? Vestas is currently looking for unskilled workers with experience in production work. We are looking for someone who wants to help ensure quality and prioritize safety and well-being in the workplace.

Being hired as a production worker at Vestas is not just about experience, it's about motivation, curiosity, and interest in learning new things. Through thorough training and instruction, we will provide you with all the tools to become skilled at making wind turbines. The Nakskov factory produces blades for our offshore wind turbines; the factory is an epoxy workplace, so everyone must complete an epoxy course or have a certificate no older than 5 years.

This posting is for those who thrive on working 12-hour shifts, either day or night.

Responsibilities

  • Safety: At Vestas, safety is the first priority, which means you must prioritize your own and your colleagues' safety, both physically and mentally.
  • Quality: Our next priority is top-notch quality, so we expect you to take pride in producing a product that meets standards.
  • Production Plan: At Vestas, we also have some plans that need to be met to deliver on time. So, we expect an employee who is diligent and strives to meet deadlines without compromising safety or quality.

Qualifications

  • You are in good physical shape and accustomed to standing and walking throughout the workday.
  • It is advantageous if you have experience with 5S and Lean.
  • It is advantageous if you have experience with production work, but if you are willing to learn, we would like to hear from you.

Competencies

  • You are quality-conscious and focus on safety.
  • You contribute to creating a good atmosphere at work.
  • You don't mind changing tasks.
  • You have an interest in learning new things and are curious.

We Offer

A workplace with a focus on employees, their safety, and providing them with the tools to create quality in their work. We offer an attractive salary package with health insurance, dental insurance, and a canteen arrangement.

Additional Information

  • Workplace: Nakskov
  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.
  • Reference check will occur after interviews. Please state in your application if you have a reference. 

Our commitment to a fair hiring.
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

DEIB Statement
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process

About Vestas
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 185 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 30,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

  • Ensuring that the café is always clean, welcoming and well presented

We are looking for someone who

  • Has experience from a café, restaurant, retail or similar environment

  • Is structured, responsible and able to keep an overview in a busy environment

  • Is positive, welcoming and professional

  • Enjoys working independently while also being a strong team player

  • Has an eye for quality and attention to detail

  • Wants to be a visible, hands-on and present manager in the café

We offer

At Patisserie Marie France A/S, you will become part of a company with proud traditions and a strong focus on quality.

We offer:

  • An exciting and varied position

  • The opportunity to make your own mark on the daily operation of the café

  • A positive working environment with great colleagues and a high level of commitment

  • Responsibility and opportunities for personal and professional development

  • A workplace where quality and excellent hospitality are at the heart of what we do

  • Salary according to qualifications

Does this sound like you?

If you are passionate about café operations, people and creating an excellent guest experience, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV to Patisserie Marie France A/S.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate.

Patisserie Marie France A/S

- Drive service quality, stability, and customer satisfaction
- Ensure services comply with UPM security, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements
- Support budgeting, cost control, forecasting, and financial transparency for services
- Ensure alignment of services with UPM IT strategy, standards, and operating model
- Collaborate closely with Service Owners, Business IT, Architects and local/site IT management

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of IT infrastructure, applications, and modern IT solutions

- Solid understanding of ITIL and ITSM practices
- Strong presentation, facilitation, and reporting skills

1 plats(er).

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta som kontaktperson till en av våra kunder. Kunden, en 13 årig kille som bor centralt i knivsta. Hans intressen är: olika fysiska aktiviteter så som fotboll, paddel och parkour. tycker även om att gå ut och äta.

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för att göra något för andra människor. Du utgår från den enskildas behov och intressen och anpassar dig efter situationer. Löneform: Timlön.
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2026-09-02  omgående, upphör: 2028-05-31  .

Knivsta kommun vill ta tillvara de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför verksamheten.

Kontakta rekryterande chef  innan du skickar in din ansökan, så får du information om hur din ansökan kan hanteras på ett säkert sätt utan att dina personuppgifter registreras öppet i systemet.

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.

The role:

As a Data Scientist, you will lead high-impact initiatives at the intersection of data science, product, and engineering. The role combines machine learning, statistics, and data engineering to solve meaningful, real-world problems, with strong collaboration at its core, working closely with stakeholders across the organization and within the team to deliver results that no single person could achieve alone.

What you will do

    Exploring the problem space and finding data science solutions that provide step increases in customer experience
    Planning data science work for the team, with an emphasis on collaboration to achieve common goals
    Gathering, collating, and understanding the data necessary to create data science products that delight the customers
    Collaborating with stakeholders throughout Truecaller to find and build data science products that solve business and customer problems at scale.
    Coaching and mentoring junior to senior data scientists to improve their technical skills and productivity

What you bring in

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
    At least 5 years of experience in using data science and machine learning to solve real-world problems
    Excellent programming skills in Python and SQL
    Solid understanding and experience with the tooling for Python - IDEs, unit testing frameworks, and static code checks
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex data and insights to non-technical stakeholders
    Strong problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset
    Customer obsession
    Able to own and drive projects and products to production and iteratively improve them over time

It would be great if you also have

    Understanding how to query very large data efficiently (we use BigQuery)
    Experience collaborating with C-suite executives
    Experience with data from mobile applications
    Experience with data visualization and reporting tools, such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI (we use Looker)
    A solid understanding of the engineering requirements necessary to put machine learning solutions into production and scale them to hundreds of millions of customers

What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:                                                                                                                                                        

    A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
    Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
    A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
    Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code:  https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/

Sounds like a great opportunity?

We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.

We only accept applications in English

jobs.title: Avdelningschef, Service, Lycksele
jobs.description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Digitalisering och Service är ett verksamhetsområde som skapats för att ännu bättre och mer effektivt stödja Hälso- och sjukvården. Vi vill möjliggöra mer tid till vård genom smarta servicelösningar och digitalisering. Digitala lösningar, innovationer och en pålitlig service är en viktig del för att klara morgondagens utmaningar för sjukvården och där ligger Region Västerbotten i framkant. Vi arbetar i nära samarbete med Hälso-och sjukvården och har en stark relation. Vi vill vara en modern och flexibel arbetsplats med många olika förmågor som kan tillgodose framtidens behov. I dagsläget ingår fem verksamheter i verksamhetsområdet, Intern service, Servicecenter, Intern logistik, CIMT och Fastighet. Vi finns i hela länet med verksamhet på alla tre sjukhusen i Västerbotten. Vi har ett spännande och utmanade arbete framför oss, tillsammans är vi starka!

Intern service och Servicecenter levererar servicetjänster med hög standard till sjukhusen. Bland annat bemannar vi receptioner, hanterar post, lokalvård och patienttransport. Genom hög tillgänglighet, effektiva processer och bemötande i världsklass skapar vi förutsättningar för en god upplevelse av oss som både vårdgivare och arbetsgivare. Intern service och Servicecenter står inför en större förändring där vi tillsammans bildar en ny basenhet under hösten 2026 - Service.

Som avdelningschef inom Service på Lycksele sjukhus har du direkt medarbetaransvar för ungefär 20 medarbetare samt en underställd sektionschef. Dina medarbetare bemannar produktionsköket och Lycksbaren, transporterar patienter och gods, är ansvarig för regionens personalbostäder och sjukhusets bårhus. Din sektionschef har personalansvar för sjukhusets lokalvårdare och receptionister.

Som chef i Region Västerbotten har du ett viktigt uppdrag både för medarbetare och invånare i länet. För att stärka dig i ditt ledarskap erbjuds du stöd och vägledning i linje med vår evidensbaserade ledarskapsfilosofi. Det kan handla om allt från tydliga ramar och smarta verktyg till utveckling på grupp- och individnivå. Med goda förutsättningar för ditt ledarskap kan du motivera, utveckla och skapa trygghet för andra.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som avdelningschef hos oss ser du helheten och potentialen samt tar oss modigt framåt.

Du agerar förebild, arbetar för att skapa gemensamma visioner och frigöra handlingskraft i din verksamhet. Du utmanar och utvecklar samt uppmuntrar och synliggör dina medarbetare. Du tar ansvar för din verksamhet utifrån dina befogenheter och företräder arbetsgivaren genom att leda och utveckla mot beslutade mål för Regionens bästa.

Du är ansvarig för Lycksele sjukhus lokalvård, reception, logistik, patienttransport, bårhus, produktionskök och Lycksbaren. Du är även ansvarig för regionens personalbostäder. Du leder och fördelar arbetet för dina närmsta medarbetare, samt har ett ansvar att driva avdelningens långsiktiga arbete. Rollen innebär också att du har ansvar för att följa upp leverantörsavtal och lokala kundavtal. Du representerar Service i samtal med andra verksamheter på Lycksele sjukhus och ingår i den lokala staben vid särskilda händelser. Du ingår i ledningsgrupp för basenheten Service.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig med relevant högskoleutbildning, alternativt annan utbildning eller erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer vara likvärdig.

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i en serviceorienterad verksamhet. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att samverka frågor mellan olika verksamheter eller funktioner, och att du har en vana att jobba med kvalitetsuppföljningar.

Du behöver kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift. Eftersom resor förekommer i tjänsten är B-körkort ett krav.

Dina ledaregenskaper är relationsinriktade och du har stark tillit till andra och tror på deras förmåga att göra ett bra jobb. Du kommunicerar med en medvetenhet om hur du uppfattas och är mån om att få fram ditt budskap på ett bra sätt. Du bygger relationer, visar hänsyn och är respektfull. Du prioriterar goda relationer och kan balansera det mot ett uppdrag som innebär att inte alltid kunna säga ja, och kan fatta beslut som är rätt för din verksamhet även om andra verksamheter inte håller med.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: 2026-12-01  eller enligt överenskommelse. .
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Uppdraget som chef inom Region Västerbotten är ett tidsbegränsat förordnande på vanligtvis 4 år, som kombineras med en tillsvidareanställning inom ditt kompetensområde.  

I rekryteringsprocessen och urval kan vi komma att använda ett arbetspsykologiskt test.

Läs mer om våra förmåner för dig som jobbar med oss på webbsidan

https://www.regionvasterbotten.se/nar-du-jobbar-hos-oss/formaner

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Om du har skyddad identitet och vill ansöka så kontaktar du rekryterande chef och skickar sedan in dina ansökningshandlingar via post.

jobs.title: Manager salle de Loisirs (H/F) (3 postes)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez l'aventure d'un nouveau centre La Tête Dans Les Nuages à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91)
Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

Dans le cadre de l'ouverture prochaine de notre nouveau site à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91), nous recherchons notre futur(e) Manager Loisirs.

Vous aimez le terrain, le management de proximité et le contact client ? Vous souhaitez participer à une ouverture de site et contribuer à sa réussite dès les premiers jours ? Alors rejoignez-nous !

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) au Directeur de Site, vous êtes un acteur clé de l'exploitation quotidienne du centre.
Véritable relais managérial sur le terrain, vous accompagnez les équipes et veillez à offrir à chaque visiteur une expérience mémorable.

- Manager et accompagner les équipes
- Participer au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.
- Former, accompagner et animer les équipes au quotidien.
- Garantir la bonne application des procédures et des standards de qualité.
- Fédérer les équipes autour de la satisfaction client et de l'esprit de service.
- Assurer le bon déroulement de l'activité durant votre présence.
- Garantir une expérience client exceptionnelle
- Accueillir et accompagner les visiteurs.
- Conseiller les clients sur les différentes offres du centre.
- Accompagner l'organisation des anniversaires, événements privés et séminaires.
- Veiller à la satisfaction des clients tout au long de leur visite.
- Gérer les éventuelles réclamations avec professionnalisme et réactivité.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du site
- Superviser les opérations d'ouverture et de fermeture du centre.
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures internes.
- Contrôler la bonne tenue des espaces de loisirs et d'accueil.
- Participer à la gestion des stocks et des approvisionnements.
- Garantir la disponibilité et la qualité des prestations proposées.
- Être un véritable ambassadeur de La Tête Dans Les Nuages
- Partager votre enthousiasme avec les équipes et les visiteurs.
- Contribuer à créer une ambiance conviviale et dynamique.
- Participer activement à la réussite commerciale du site.

Votre profil
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +2 minimum ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente.
Vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en management de proximité, idéalement dans l'un des secteurs suivants :
Loisirs, Restauration, Commerce / Retail, Hôtellerie, Evénementiel, Distribution.

Votre excellent relationnel, votre sens du service client, votre leadership naturel, votre dynamisme et votre esprit d'équipe, votre capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives, votre goût pour le terrain et l'opérationnel.

Vous appréciez les environnements dynamiques où aucune journée ne ressemble à une autre.

Horaires aménagés dans le respect de la réglementation du travail.

Tickets restaurant après 2 mois d'ancienneté.
Mutuelle d'entreprise.
Prise en charge des transports en commun à hauteur de 50 %.
Intégration au sein d'un groupe leader du loisir indoor.
Participation à l'ouverture d'un nouveau site ambitieux.

jobs.title: Teamledare till StoppCenter
jobs.description:
Är du lyhörd och har förmåga att anpassa ditt ledarskap efter rådande behov? Är du en lösningsorienterad person som vill bidra med din kreativitet och energi till gruppen? Sök då till oss! Vi söker nu en teamledare för ett vikariat på ett år.

StoppCenter är en enhet som arbetar mot våld i nära relation där vi har samlat myndighetsutövning och insatser inom samma enhet. Målet med vår verksamhet är att vara ett stöd till alla parter i en familj där det förekommer våld. Vi är stolta över det arbete vi bedriver tillsammans inom enheten och i samverkan med andra för målgruppen viktiga aktörer.

Vill du veta mer om vår verksamhet? Se via länk nedan:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6gSBBLrgWks

www.eskilstuna.se/vald

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som teamledare arbetar du tillsammans med medarbetarna genom att stötta, motivera och vägleda dem i sitt arbete, både individuellt och i grupp. Vi värdesätter teamet och ser att du som ledare verkar för ett gott samarbetsklimat och en god kultur på arbetsplatsen.

Du fördelar och prioriterar uppdrag och har kontinuerliga ärendegenomgångar med varje medarbetare. Vi ser hela tiden att enheten utvecklas och förbättras, och din roll blir att se till att utvecklingsarbetet drivs framåt och mot enhetens mål. Vidare har du det övergripande ansvaret att medarbetarna håller en hög kvalitet i sin dokumentation.

Du arbetar nära enhetschef och teamledarkollega. Du ingår i enhetens ledningsgrupp där vi leder verksamheten tillsammans. Vi stöttar varandra och hjälps åt i det gemensamma uppdraget på enheten och i att leda enhetens medarbetare. Du samarbetar och samverkar med många andra myndigheter, andra enheter och andra teamledare inom förvaltningen.

KVALIFIKATIONER
För tjänsten krävs att du har socionomexamen. Du behöver också ha B-körkort och erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning, inom individ och familjeomsorg. Det är starkt meriterande med erfarenhet av arbete med våld i nära relationer och av arbete i ledande roller, exempelvis som gruppledare eller teamledare.

Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga för oss. Vi söker dig som har ett professionellt och tryggt förhållningssätt och som kan behålla lugnet även när tempot är högt. Du trivs med att strukturera och planera ditt arbete, men är samtidigt flexibel och hittar gärna nya lösningar när förutsättningarna förändras. Du är en person som bidrar till ett gott samarbete och som har lätt för att skapa och vårda relationer. I ditt arbetssätt är du prestigelös och hjälpsam.

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: Snarast eller enligt ök.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Socialförvaltningen ansvarar för arbetet med att skapa social trygghet för barn, ungdomar och vuxna. Målet är att arbeta för att uppnå social uthållighet. Inom socialförvaltningen bedrivs kvalificerat och välutvecklat socialt arbete. Förvaltningens arbete innehåller både myndighetsutövning samt behandlande och stödjande insatser för barn, ungdomar, vuxna och familjer.

Vill du vara med och leda vägen?

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats som går före och leder vägen i en av Sveriges mest hållbara kommuner. Tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade medarbetare är du med och utvecklar Eskilstuna genom goda hållbara möten, vägledning och service. Genom ett aktivt och modigt medarbetarskap samt ett tillitsfullt och engagerat ledarskap är du med och driver förändring. Du gör skillnad för människor varje dag.

Vi välkomnar medarbetare med olika bakgrund och arbetar för att våra arbetsplatser ska vara tillgängliga för alla.

Om du har skyddad identitet ansöker du genom att skicka in din ansökan skriftligen eller lämna den i vår reception på Alva Myrdals Gata 3 D. Märk din ansökan med Rekryteringsenheten och annonsens referensnummer.

Kokoonpanija tuotantoon

Etsimme arvostetulle teollisuusalan asiakkaallemme mekaanista asentajaa kokoonpanotehtäviin tuotantoon.

Asiakkaamme suunnittelee ja valmistaa omia suunnittelemiaan tuotteita eri laitevalmistajille teollisuuden tarpeisiin. Toimintaa ohjaa korkea laatu, vahva osaaminen ja pitkä kokemus alalta.

Tehtävässäsi

Pääset työskentelemään kokoonpano tiimissä tehden itsenäisesti monipuolista mekaanista osakokoonpanoa. Työssä pääset näkemään konkreettisesti kättesi jäljen sekä osallistumaan laadukkaiden tuotteiden valmistukseen alusta loppuun.

Työsi sisältää mm.:

- mekaanista asennus- ja kokoonpanotyötä

- teknisten piirustusten lukemista ja hyödyntämistä

- vianetsintää ja ongelmanratkaisua tuotannon eri vaiheissa, ennenkuin tuote lähtee ulos

- yhteistyötä kokeneen tiimin kanssa

Odotamme sinulta

Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta
Aikaisempaa kokemusta sarjatuotannon kokoonpanoista tai mekaanisista asennustyö kokemusta teollisuusympäristössä
Hyvää piirustusten lukutaitoa
Ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti, että osana tiimiä

Eduksi katsomme:

- erilaisten käsityökalujen käyttötaidot

- kokemuksen mekaanisesta asentamisesta ja kappaleiden käsittelystä

- ERP-järjestelmän käyttökokemusta

Tarjoamme sinulle

Vakaan ja arvostetun työnantajan
Modernit työvälineet ja siistin työympäristön
Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön
Vaihtelevan työn, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi

Työsuhde alkaa määräaikaisena, mutta tavoitteena on pitkäaikainen yhteistyö. Työ on kokopäivätyötä arkisin, ja sitä tehdään 1–2 vuorossa, joten valmius vuorotyöhön on tärkeää.

Palkkaus määräytyy kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä – toimi siis nopeasti!

Huomioithan, että emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tietosuojasyistä.


Talent ValtaGroup

Talent ValtaGroup on rekrytointeihin ja henkilöstövuokraukseen erikoistunut yritys, jonka toiminnassa yhdistyvät vahva asiantuntemus ja aito välittäminen. Uskomme, että onnistunut rekrytointi ei ole pelkkää osaajien ja yritysten yhdistämistä – se on ihmisten urapolkujen ja organisaatioiden menestyksen rakentamista.

Meillä rekrytointi tehdään tunteella ja taidolla. Kohtaamme sekä asiakkaat että ehdokkaat yksilöinä, kuunnellen ja ymmärtäen heidän tarpeensa. Toimimme avoimesti, joustavasti ja vastuullisesti varmistaen, että jokainen rekrytointiprosessi on sujuva ja ehdokaskokemus laadukas.

Pitkä kokemuksemme eri toimialojen rekrytoinneista ja henkilöstövuokrauksesta on tuonut meille kyvyn löytää juuri oikeat osaajat oikeisiin paikkoihin – tavalla, joka tuntuu oikealta.

jobs.title: Gald og sosial 8-åring søker tilkallingsvikarer til BPA-teamet sitt - bli en viktig del av hverdagen min! 😊
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Tilkallingsvikar
⏰ Arbeidstid: Hovedsakelig nattevakt, samt helg (dag/natt) og enkelte dagvakter i ukedager

Jeg er en glad og sosial gutt på 8 år som lyser opp rommet og sjarmerer de fleste jeg møter. Jeg er veldig interessert i mennesker. Musikk, lek og tull er noe av det beste jeg vet, og jeg synes rampestreker kan være ganske morsomme.

Jeg er nysgjerrig og følger godt med på det som skjer rundt meg. Nye ord og fraser plukker jeg raskt opp, og jeg lærer stadig nye ting.

Jeg har begrenset talespråk, og det kan til tider være vanskelig å forstå det jeg sier. Derfor bruker jeg tegn og symboler som støtte i kommunikasjonen. Samtidig er jeg tydelig på hva jeg vil og ikke vil, og følelsene mine er som regel lette å lese. Jeg har også store følelser og trenger voksne som kan gi meg både rom og god veiledning når følelsene blir sterke. Jeg er tospråklig og forstår både norsk og engelsk, men snakker mest engelsk.

På grunn av motoriske og utviklingsmessige forsinkelser bruker jeg rullestol og trenger støtte i hverdagen. Derfor ser jeg etter en assistent som ønsker å bli kjent med meg og være med over tid.

Høres dette ut som en jobb for deg? Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Stilling og arbeidstid:

Jeg ser nå etter tilkallingsvikarer! Vaktene tilbys etter behov, ved sykdom, ferie og ved ekstravakter, og kan være:

  • Nattevakt (våken): 23:30–08:00/09:00

  • Helg: 08:45–14:15, lørdag og søndag

  • Enkelte dagvakter i ukedager: varierende tidspunkt, vanligvis rundt 09:00–13:00

Du trenger ikke være tilgjengelig for alle vaktene, men du må kunne jobbe natt og helg ved behov.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Medisinsk oppfølging:

    • Observasjon ved bruk av CPAP

    • Administrasjon av måltider via PEG-knapp

    • Medisinering

  • Praktisk assistanse:

    • Bistand til personlig stell og av- og påkledning

    • Forflytning og fysisk støtte

  • Aktiviteter og lek:

    • Delta i aktiviteter og leker med meg

    • Bistå og finne på ulike aktiviteter som passer for meg

  • Husarbeid og rydding:

    • Vask av flasker og rengjøring av eventuelle søl

    • Rydding av søppel og hjelp med generell opprydning

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Som brukerstyrt personlig assistent utgjør du en stor forskjell, derfor er personlig egnethet og kjemi svært viktig.

  • Det er viktig at du kan kommunisere godt på engelsk.

  • Du må være komfortabel med å løfte og bistå ved forflytning.

  • Det er ønskelig med erfaring fra arbeid med barn eller innen helse- og omsorgssektoren.

  • Du bør være i god helse og ha en livssituasjon som gjør det forenlig å jobbe våkne nattevakter.

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Pålitelig, detaljorientert og punktlig

  • Lærevillig og trygg i å stille spørsmål når noe er uklart

  • Ryddig, selvdreven og selvstendig

  • Flink med barn og god til å kommunisere

Dette er en jobb som passer best for deg som trives med å jobbe selvstendig, setter pris på faste rutiner og er nøyaktig og samvittighetsfull. Rollen innebærer et stort ansvar, og vi ser etter noen som ikke lar seg skremme av det, men som finner trygghet i klare rammer og oppgaver.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Karen Tonette Bulæg på epost karen.bulag@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

jobs.title: Hallintosihteeri
jobs.description:
**Hallintosihteeri Pancho Villa Finland Oy:lle**

Haluaisitko olla osa Pancho Villa -franchising-ketjun loistokasta tarinaa? Avaamme haun täysin uuteen tehtävään ketjun näköalapaikalle!

Meillä Pancho Villassa pääset osaksi rentoa, mutkatonta ja eteenpäin menevää työyhteisöä. Olemme vahvasti kasvava kotimainen ravintolaketju, jossa välitämme työntekijöistämme ja tuemme toistemme onnistumista. "Pancho-perheessä" viihdytään pitkään, sillä arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa, luotamme työntekijöihimme ja ylläpidämme avointa keskustelukulttuuria.

**Olisitko sinä etsimämme hallintosihteeri?**

Etsimme huolellista ja tarkkaa hallintosihteeriä vakituiseen tehtävään, jossa olet merkittävä osatekijä Pancho Villan menestyksessä. Työ sisältää muun muassa osto- ja myyntireskontran hoitoa, laskutusta, tiliöintiä sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä tilitoimiston, tavarantoimittajien ja ketjun yrittäjien kanssa. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu sopimuskannan ylläpitoa sekä kuittien ja kuluraporttien esikäsittelyä. Pääset myös järjestämään erilaisia kokoustilaisuuksia, ketjupäiviä sekä muita sisäisiä tapahtumia.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- **Joustavat työajat:** Voit rytmittää työpäiväsi vapaasti, kunhan olet tavoitettavissa ketjun yrittäjille ja yhteistyökumppaneille arkisin ydinajat klo 9.00–14.00.

- **Vapautta ja vastuuta:** Mahdollisuuden työskennellä etänä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Toimistomme sijaitsee **Tampereella,** jonne toivomme sinun pääsevän tarvittaessa.

- **Reilun palkkauksen:** Kilpailukykyisen palkan, josta haluamme kuulla palkkatoiveesi. Palkka tehtävässä on noin 2 300–3 400 €/kk riippuen osaamisesta, kokemuksesta ja tehtäväkuvan laajuudesta.

- **Kattavat edut:** Liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun: ePassi, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä tietenkin tuntuvat henkilökunta-alennukset ketjumme ravintoloihin ympäri Suomen.

- **Täyden tuen:** Nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä mahtavan tiimin tuen, meillä et jää tehtäviesi kanssa yksin.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Kokemusta myynti- ja ostoreskontran hoitamisesta Procountorilla

- Kaupallista koulutusta, esim. merkonomi tai tradenomi

- Taitoa hahmottaa monimutkaisiakin kokonaisuuksia

- Vahvaa tietoteknistä osaamista ja uusien järjestelmien omaksumiskykyä

- Huolellisuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja täsmällisyyttä


**Arvostamme:**

- Kykyä kannatella samanaikaisesti useita lankoja

- Sujuvia tiimi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Positiivista otetta ja kehittämishalua


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Toimitusjohtaja Teemu Vanharanta, teemu.vanharanta@panchovilla.fi

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi palkkatoiveineen osoitteeseen **rekry@panchovilla.fi** viimeistään **25.9.2026**. Toimi kuitenkin nopeasti, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajan puitteissa ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

jobs.title: Health, Safety & Working Environment Advisor
jobs.description:
Petrolink Support ser etter en erfaren rådgiver innen helse, sikkerhet og arbeidsmiljø for å sikre den daglige driften av Offshore Helseklinikk i samsvar med lover og forskrifter.

Lokasjon: Offshore

Rotasjon: 14/28


Arbeidsoppgaver

• Sikre daglig drift av Offshore Helseklinikk i samsvar med lover og forskrifter, inkl. vedlikeholde beholdning og kontroll av medisiner og medisinsk utstyr, samt utstyr knyttet til nødhospital og håndtering av smittsomme sykdommer og epidemier.

• Yte faglig helsehjelp og gjennomføre medisinske undersøkelser og behandling av pasienter i samarbeid med vaktlege

• Gjennomføre risikobaserte helseundersøkelser i henhold til oppsatt program

• Dokumentere alle testresultater i den ansattes medisinsk journal

• Gjennomføre medisinske undersøkelser for å sertifisere SAR-medlemmer og sikre dokumentasjon i henhold til prosedyrer

• Gjennomføre ukentlig trening og opplæring for førstehjelpsgruppen og lede gruppen ved medisinsk nødsituasjon

• Gi råd og implementere nødvendige kontrolltiltak ved utbrudd av smittsomme sykdommer eller epidemier, i samarbeid med fagansvarlig lege

• Sikre at alt medisinsk-teknisk utstyr vedlikeholdes og kalibreres i henhold til produsentens anbefalinger

• Gjennomføre regelmessig testing, dokumentering og rapportering av drikkevann (prøvetaking) for å verifisere vannkvalitet.

• Iverksette og lede regelmessige hygienerunder i henhold til plan

• Bidra til å beskytte arbeidstakere mot eksponering for helseskadelige arbeidsmiljøfaktorer
  Dette inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

- Identifikasjon av helserisikofaktorer på arbeidsplassen (fysiske, psykologiske, kjemiske, biologiske og ergonomiske faktorer)

- Delta og bidra i arbeidstillatelses-møter og Sikker jobbanalyse-møter for å gi råd om avbøtende tiltak i henhold til kontrollhierarki

- Oppfølging av gjennomføring av arbeidsoppgaver i felten gjennom jobobservasjoner og inspeksjoner

- Gi informasjon til offshore-mannskap (befolkninger) basert på risikovurdering og kartlegging av arbeidsmiljøet

- Gi råd og veiledning om håndtering av kjemikalier

• Ved påvisning av tegn og symptomer på mulig arbeidsrelatert sykdom eller skade, gjennomføre innledende intervju og undersøkelser

- Varsle og rapportere resultatene til bedriftshelsetjenesten i henhold til prosedyrer. Informere fagansvarlig lege

- I samsvar med forskrifter, oppdatere eksponeringsregister med nødvendige detaljer dersom personell er eksponert for helseskadelige stoffer og kjemikalier

- Videreformidle avvik i sikkerhets og arbeidsmiljørelaterte forhold til relevante fagpersoner i landorganisasjonen. Formidle råd og foreslåtte avbøtende tiltak til offshore ledergruppe

• Delta og bidra i oppsatte møter med fagpersonell på land

Kvalifikasjoner

• Offentlig Godkjent Sykepleier, helst med spesialutdanning innenfor anestesi, akuttmedisin eller intensivsykepleie

• Erfaring fra offshore aktivitet innen petroleumsindustrien (ikke fra maritim sektor)

• Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring klinisk erfaring, helst etter spesialutdannelse, men annen erfaring innen akuttmedisin eller prehospital tjeneste vil også vektlegges

• Erfaring fra arbeid knyttet il risikovurderinger og målinger innen arbeidsmiljø (støy, vibrasjoner, kjemisk, biologisk og psykososial ekponering)

• Kjennskap til arbeidsmiljølovgivning, HMS forskrifter og -standarder (spesielt NORSOK S-002, C-001 og C-002)

• Gode kommunikasjons -og samarbeidsegenskaper

• Flytende både skriftlig og muntlig i norsk og engelsk

Personlige egenskaper

• Entusiastisk og gode samarbeidsevner

• HMS, strukturert og resultatorientert holdning

• Opptre selvstendig og kunne styre egne aktiviteter

Vi tilbyr

• Ansettelse med konkurransedyktige betingelser 

• Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger

Petrolink Support støtter drift av plattformer, havbunnsanlegg og flytende produksjonsenheter til havs, olje- og gassterminaler på land, raffinerier og prosessanlegg inkludert LNG-terminaler samt anlegg for kraftproduksjon og karbonfangst. jobs.title: SAP Developer
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

We're hiring an SAP Developer to join BLP. In this role, you'll be responsible for integrating BLP into a wide range of SAP systems, including complex enterprise landscapes. This is a high-impact position-deep ERP integration is central to the value our Al solution delivers.

Our product adapts to the unique needs of each customer while still offering a plug-and-play experience across diverse environments. We're looking for engineers who take ownership, bring expertise, and are motivated to keep improving this balance.

You should be comfortable operating at scale and willing to rethink established approaches. This is a chance to join a focused, experienced team of SAP engineers who take pride in what they build and are committed to pushing the product forward at a rapid pace.

How we work

• AI-First & Data-Driven: We make sure to leverage the latest tech (or build our own) to let our people put their

brains to use where they matter most

• In control. As a self-financed startup, we make decisions, not investors

• Ownership: We own our work, our wins, and our mistakes. It's how we grow and improve

• Excellence: We don't settle for "good enough." Exceptional is the bar, in everything we do

• Transparency: What you see is what you get. Open communication, honest processes, and no surprises

• Candour: Bold, honest conversations that inspire new ideas and solve problems

What You'll Do

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand project requirements and translate them into technical specifications and deliverables

• Enhance and expand our powerful SAP integrations by developing ABAP and Golang code

• Perform code reviews and ensure high engineering standards

• Support Project and Sales teams to ensure smooth deliveries, including joining customer calls for requirements and troubleshooting during integrations

We're excited about you because

• You have 2+ years of hands-on experience in SAP ERP integrations, development, or technical consulting

• Solid engineering mindset with a drive for building products, not just projects

• Experience in ABAP OO and OData services, or a strong interest in mastering them

• Openness to coding in backend languages beyond SAP, with a focus on Golang

• Exposure to major SAP modules (FI, MM, SD)

• Familiarity with modern software practices (Git, Code Reviews, Unit Testing, CI/CD, DevOps mindset)

• Hands-on Golang development experience

• Fluency in English, German is a plus

You'll get

• Solve real problems, fast. Join a high-growth deep-tech startup tackling real-world challenges for global industry leaders.

• Build from zero to one. Take ownership of our integration ecosystem — shaping its foundations and direction from the ground up.

• Opportunities to grow. You're controlling your personal development and career trajectory in a rapidly growing, internationally expanding startup

• Exceptional colleagues. You'll be growing alongside individuals from exceptional academic backgrounds and careers

Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. Your Story



Must’s:

Why Beyond Gravity?

You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!

We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!

jobs.title: Senior Design Manager - Mechanical
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Design Manager - Mechanical to lead the mechanical and plumbing design delivery for our EPC projects for data center projects. This role sits within the Design Engineering function and is responsible for directing and quality-controlling the work of external engineering consultants, ensuring mechanical and plumbing designs are delivered on time, to budget and in line with  technical, safety, and operational standards for mission-critical facilities.

The Mechanical Senior Design Manager acts as the technical authority and single point of accountability for mechanical and plumbing design across assigned projects, working closely with other design disciplines, project delivery teams and both internal and external stakeholders to ensure a fully coordinated, constructible and operationally sound design solution.

Leadership of External Design Consultants

• Direct, brief, and manage external mechanical and plumbing engineering consultants across all project design stages, from concept through to issued-for-construction (IFC) and as-built documentation.

• Set clear design deliverables, quality expectations, and programme milestones for consultants, and hold them accountable against the agreed scope, fee, and schedule.

• Review and critically challenge consultant deliverables — calculations, schematics, drawings, specifications, and equipment schedules — before issue, ensuring technical robustness and compliance.

• Identify design risks, gaps, or underperformance early and drive timely corrective action with consultant teams.

Mechanical & Plumbing Technical Oversight

• Provide senior technical oversight of HVAC and cooling system design for data center environments, including CRAH/CRAC units, chilled water systems, chillers, free/adiabatic cooling, air handling, and airflow management.

• Oversee plumbing, drainage, and fire protection system design (including pre-action and other special hazard suppression systems typical of data center white space and support areas).

• Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and client/industry requirements (e.g. ASHRAE, local building and mechanical codes, Uptime Institute Tier requirements, and client-specific design criteria).

• Support resiliency, redundancy, and availability targets (e.g. N, N+1, 2N configurations) appropriate to each project's target tier and client specification.

Multi-Discipline Coordination

• Act as the mechanical/plumbing lead within the wider multi-discipline design team, coordinating closely with electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, and fire/life-safety disciplines.

• Drive resolution of cross-discipline clashes and interface issues through structured coordination reviews, including BIM/model-based coordination where applicable.

• Ensure mechanical and plumbing design integrates cleanly with construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and site logistics.

Stakeholder & Client Management

• Serve as the primary mechanical/plumbing design point of contact for internal stakeholders (project directors, project managers, construction teams, procurement) and external stakeholders (clients, authorities having jurisdiction, third-party reviewers, and commissioning agents).

• Present design status, key decisions, and risks clearly to stakeholders at design reviews and project governance meetings.

• Support commercial and procurement processes by providing technical input on consultant scopes, equipment selection,and vendor/contractor queries.

Mekaniker – tekniker – reparation af gear og gearkasser – Aarhus

 

Er du typen, der gerne vil vide, hvorfor noget ikke virker – og som helst selv vil skille det ad for at finde fejlen?

 

PRONOR IndustriTeknik as søger en dygtig mekaniker/tekniker til vores afdeling i Aarhus. Du bliver en del af vores værksted, hvor du primært kommer til at arbejde med reparation og renovering af gear og gearkasser. Derudover arbejder vi med reparation og service af blandt andet elmotorer, generatorer og pumper til industrien. Du får derfor en hverdag med forskellige tekniske udfordringer og mulighed for at bruge dine praktiske evner. Du bliver en del af teamet i Aarhus og får reference til afdelingslederen.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du er uddannet mekaniker eller har en tilsvarende teknisk baggrund – og du har solid erfaring med reparation af gear og gearkasser fra f.eks. biler, lastbiler eller entreprenørmaskiner.

Du har praktisk erfaring med hele processen fra:

  • Adskillelse og fejlfinding

  • Udskiftning af lejer, tandhjul og pakninger

  • Kontrol og vurdering af slidte komponenter

  • Samling og slutmontage

  • Test og afprøvning

Har du også erfaring med reparation og fejlfinding på industrielle maskiner er det en klar fordel.

Det vigtigste er dog, at du kan lide at arbejde med teknik og mekanik og, at du tager ansvar for dine opgaver. Du arbejder selvstændigt, tænker i løsninger og giver ikke bare op, når noget driller.

Du er samtidig en god kollega, har et godt humør og sætter pris på et arbejdsmiljø, hvor man hjælper hinanden og får tingene til at fungere.

 

Hvad får du hos os?

Hos PRONOR får du en central rolle i vores værksted og bliver en vigtig del af vores afdeling i Aarhus.

Vi har en åben og uformel organisation med korte beslutningsveje, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling. Du får mulighed for at arbejde med forskellige tekniske opgaver og bruge din erfaring i praksis.

Vi tilbyder løn og ansættelsesvilkår på et konkurrencedygtigt niveau.

 

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Peter Steiniche på 20 66 18 19. Lyder det som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning og dit CV til hene@pronor.dk og skriv ”Geartekniker – Aarhus” i emnefeltet. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede nu.

 

Lidt om PRONOR IndustriTeknik

PRONOR IndustriTeknik as servicerer mere end 2000 kunder i Danmark med reservedele og tekniske komponenter samt service og reparation af industritekniske anlæg. Alt med henblik på at optimere og holde produktionen kørende - uden dyre og unødvendige produktionsstop. Derfor er vores motto: ”Vi holder hjulene i gang” og det er præcis, hvad vi gør – med udgangspunkt i vores ambition om altid at være professionelle, produktive og proaktive.

PRONOR har 25 medarbejdere og afdelinger i: Århus, København, Ringe, Aalborg. Læs mere på: www.pronor.dk

jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Engineering within Robotics
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Robotics. The candidate is expected to start on January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of Robotics, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: 

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Have research experience in computer vision fields related to laboratory automation. This could include (but is not limited to) methods for:

    • vision-based handling of laboratory equipment, in particular glassware and fluids 

    • segmentation and vision-based handling of medical specimens and fluids

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of Robotics, such as robotics control, modelling, computer vision, medical/industrial robotics and artificial intelligence. 

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network, are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

 

The Department

MMMI

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The institute is the origin of robotics research in Denmark and has spawned the world-renowned cluster of robotics in Odense with more than 130 robotics companies including Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots. Building on our expertise in AI, robotics and software, we have raised strong research centres in related domains, such as Health Informatics and Energy Informatics, Drones and other relevant research areas. 

SDU Robotics

SDU Robotics conducts research among others within the fields of robotics and computer vision. The unit focuses on research problems from real robotics applications within manufacturing industries, hospitals, elderly care, and other partners in society. The unit also focuses on Robot related vision technologies for facilitating industrial part feeding, automated product assembly, uncertainty aware quality inspection, and biomedical segmentation for diagnosis and robot control. 

SDU Robotics’ research involves mathematical modeling and control of robots, robotic processes and robot systems, human-robot interactions, computer vision for reliable inspection and robot control, and simulation technologies for robotics and computer vision aimed at closing the Sim2Real gap. Artificial Intelligence is widely applied within all research fields. 

 

Additional information

For further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For more questions about the position please contact Head of Unit, Professor Thiusius Rajeeth Savarimuthu at trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The candidate will be attached to The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute in Odense and is also expected to participate in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense regularly.
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Further information on salary and taxation.

 

The tenure track programme the Faculty of Engineering is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. Candidates enter the assistant professor level (for up to 6 years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position of associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented independent scholarly output, ground-breaking publications, achievement of excellence grants, and international research network.
Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

To qualify for the position, you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. 

 

Application requirements
The application must include the following:

  • Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

  • Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

  • An elaborate research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

  • Up to five of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload a pdf for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

  • Teaching Portfolio as documentation for teaching and learning experience as well as supervision qualifications. Any format is acceptable, but you can find inspiration for structuring your teaching portfolio on the Faculty's teaching portfolio page.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

Submission guidelines

  • All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be protected by password. 

  • Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. 

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation and references may be obtained. 

 

About SDU
SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.
SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.



Equal opportunity employment
The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.



How to apply
Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply online" link provided in the job posting.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.
 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

jobs.description:
HVEM LEDER VI EFTER:

Da Lea er gået på barsel, søger vi en omsorgsfuld og livsglad pædagog, som har lyst til at være medskaber af et omsorgsfuldt lærerigt børnemiljø. Du skal være glad for arbejdet med målgruppen, kunne være med til at skabe en tryg og genkendelig struktur omkring børnenes hverdag, samtidig med at vi følger børnenes interesser.

Vi søger en pædagog, der sammen med vi andre kan være en aktiv medskaber af et rigt børneliv. Vi er et engageret og inspirerende personaleteam, hvor der bl.a. er fokus på arbejdsglæde, begejstring, forundring, forvandling, anerkendelse, relationer og faglig stolthed. Du skal i dette selskab være med til at bruge vores hus, vores skønne uderum og naturen omkring os til at give børnene en aktiv og lærerig dag.

HVEM KOMMER DU TIL AT ARBEJDE MED:

Børnehaven Højvang er en privat børnehave med 44 børn i alderen 2-6 år. Vi bor i Skæring/Egå tæt på skov og strand, og derfor skal du også gerne have en interesse i udeliv.

Vi er en personalegruppe på otte engagerede kolleger. Vi har åbne døre, således at børnene har mulighed for at bevæge sig rundt i hele huset og indgå i leg og aktiviteter efter eget ønske. Det betyder, at man engagerer sig i alle husets børn og forældre. Du vil opleve personalegruppen som en grundglad, social og imødekommende gruppe af kvinder og mænd, som sætter samarbejde på tværs af huset højt.

Vi er på gulvet sammen med børnene og møder dem positivt med glæde og varme. Det skal være udfordrende, sjovt og givende at gå på arbejde, og vi ved, at vi er hinandens forudsætninger for at lykkes med vores pædagogik og skabe et godt børneliv for børnene i Højvang.

VI TILBYDER:

  • en fast stilling som pædagog i et hus med mange muligheder og "højt til loftet", hvor der ikke er langt fra tanke til handling.

  • et hus med fokus på det gode børneliv for alle børn.

  • et hus med åbenhed for nye ideer og tiltag

  • et hus hvor du kan være medskaber af, samt sætte dit eget præg på pædagogikken og faglige retning i tæt samarbejde med kolleger.

  • et hus med stor forældreopbakning og en engageret forældregruppe, der har overskud til både at yde og stille krav til et godt trivsels- og læringsmiljø for deres børn.

VI FORVENTER, AT DU

  • har noget på hjertet for det enkelte barn.

  • har en særlig interesse i aldersgruppen samt viden og færdigheder til at være medskaber af den pædagogiske hverdag.

  • er uddannet pædagog og kan bruge din viden aktivt med børnene.

  • vil dialogen, reflektionen og kan gribe hverdagen, så at både store og små bliver set, hørt og værdsat.

TILTRÆDELSE: Gerne 1 oktober 2026 eller efter aftale. Arbejdstid 34 timer om ugen ( timetal til forhandling).

jobs.title: Chef de Partie
jobs.description:

SMC Ltd are recruiting a Chef de Partie for a restaurant in Dublin City Centre. As Chef de Partie, you will build a kitchen culture where high standards, teamwork, cleanliness and pride are evident in every service. This is a role for someone who enjoys maintaining an exceptionally clean and organised kitchen, and delivering outstanding food every day. The Role You will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day running of the kitchen, ensuring exceptional food quality and working as part of a team. You will lead operations while maintaining the highest standards of food, cleanliness, organisation and service.Key Responsibilities Team Development Lead, motivate and inspire the kitchen team Create a positive, respectful and supportive working environment. Lead by example with professionalism, consistency and a strong work ethic. Encourage teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement. Build a culture where everyone takes pride in the food they produce. Kitchen Operations Oversee the day-to-day operation of the kitchen. Ensure every dish is prepared and presented to consistently high standards. Deliver smooth, efficient service without compromising quality. Ensure recipes and specifications are followed at all times. Maintain excellent communication throughout the kitchen. Food Safety & Kitchen Standards Maintain excellent HACCP and food safety standards. Ensure the kitchen is always clean, organised and exceptionally well maintained. Oversee food storage, stock rotation and labelling. Promote a culture where cleanliness is everyone's responsibility. About You Minimum 2 years experience as a Chef de Partie or Experience within a busy, quality-focused restaurant. Passionate about producing exceptional food every day. Excellent organisational and communication skills. HACCP certification required. Flexible to work evenings, weekends and public holidays. Applicant must have experience using Rational oven.

jobs.title: Helsefagarbeider hjemmetjenesten
jobs.description:
Er du helsefagarbeider og klar for et nytt kapittel?
Tjenester for hjemmeboende sentrum består av fire hjemmesykepleieteam, samlokalisert på Hamborgstrøm bo- og servicesenter.
Team 3 søker nå dedikerte og ansvarsbevisste helsefagarbeidere til fast 100 % stilling i todelt turnus.
Arbeidstiden er dag- og kveldsarbeid, med arbeid hver tredje helg eller langvakter hver fjerde helg. Arbeidet utføres i brukernes hjem, og tjenestebil benyttes.

Vi vet at en trygg og faglig solid oppstart er avgjørende. Hos oss får du:
- Individuelt tilpasset opplæringsplan med tett oppfølging
- Fadderordning med erfarne kollegaer som gir støtte og veiledning
- Mulighet for kompetanseheving gjennom kurs og internundervisning

Som helsefagarbeider i team 3 vil du:
- Gi helhetlig og personsentrert pleie og omsorg til hjemmeboende brukere
- Bidra til å skape trygghet og mestring i brukernes hverdag
- Samarbeide tett med kollegaer og pårørende
- Delta aktivt i faglig utviklingsarbeid og forbedring av tjenestene

Vi ser etter deg som:
- Har god digital kompetanse og er trygg i bruk av dokumentasjonssystemer og velferdsteknologi
- Evner å følge opp primærkontaktoppgaver på en strukturert og kvalitetsbevisst måte
- Tar ansvar for planlegging, dokumentasjon og oppfølging av brukere
- Har interesse for, og et ønske om å utvikle kompetanse innen demensomsorg
- Ønsker å bidra aktivt til fagutvikling i teamet

Velkommen som søker hos oss!

For stillinger der det er krav om politiattest, etter gjeldende lover vil dette bli innhentet i forbindelse med signering av arbeidsavtalen, før tiltredelse.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utfører helsefaglige prosedyrer som sårstell, kateterpleie og blodsukkermåling
  • Håndterer medikamenter etter gjeldende retningslinjer og delegasjon
  • Bistår brukere med personlig hygiene, ernæring og daglige gjøremål
  • Følger opp brukere med kroniske og sammensatte helseutfordringer
  • Dokumenterer og rapporterer i elektronisk pasientjournal (Gerica)
  • Samarbeider tett med sykepleiere, fastleger, pårørende og andre tjenester
  • Går ansvarsvakter og bidrar til koordinering og kvalitetssikring av tjenestene
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider
  • Erfaring fra hjemmesykepleie eller annet relevant arbeid innen pleie og omsorg er en fordel
  • Evne til å jobbe selvstendig og strukturert, samtidig som du samarbeider godt i team
  • Trygg i bruk av digitale verktøy og dokumentasjonssystemer 
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner og evne til å møte brukere,  pårørende og kollegaer med respekt og omsorg
  • Ansvarsbevisst, fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • For søkere med annen utdanning enn norsk, kreves dokumenterte språkkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig på nivå B2. Dette gjelder ikke skandinaviske søkere. Dokumentasjon vedlegges søknaden. 
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du har et genuint engasjement for hjemmebasert omsorg
  • Du trives med varierte arbeidsdager og faglige utfordringer
  • Du bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø og deler kunnskap med kollegaer
  • Du er faglig trygg, og tar initiativ til å sikre kvalitet i tjenestene
Vi tilbyr
  • Et arbeidsmiljø preget av tillit, faglig stolthet og godt samarbeid
  • En hverdag med stor variasjon, der du får bruke hele bredden av din kompetanse
  • Kollegaer som heier på deg og deler både kunnskap og erfaringer
  • Tid og rom til å bli trygg i rollen – vi spiller hverandre gode
  • Gode rammer for faglig utvikling og personlig vekst
  • En jobb hvor du hver dag merker at det du gjør har betydning
  • Fast ansettelse i 100 % stilling og en turnus med forutsigbarhet og balanse

Vedlagt søknaden legges relevante vitnemål og attester. Vitnemålsportalen skal benyttes for vitnemål som er registrert i denne portalen. Har du utdanning fra utlandet legger du ved godkjenning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse eller NOKUT. 

I henhold til Offentleglova kan vi være forpliktet til å offentliggjøre opplysninger om søkere som har bedt om å bli unntatt offentlighet.
