jobs.title: Mekaniker
jobs.description:
Vi søker deg som har relevant teknisk bakgrunn og et ønske om å videreutvikle kompetansen din innen fagområdet. Du trives med å ta ansvar, arbeide strukturert og finne gode løsninger i møte med både små og store utfordringer. Vi legger stor vekt på personlige egenskaper, og ser etter en kollega som er positiv, serviceinnstilt og som møter både gjester og medarbeidere med et profesjonelt og imøtekommende vesen. Hos oss blir du en viktig del av helhetsopplevelsen, og du bidrar aktivt til at våre gjester får en trygg og minnerik fjellopplevelse – hver eneste dag.

Som mekaniker jobber du med reparasjoner og vedlikehold av vårt tekniske utstyr og prepareringsmaskiner.

Du er en problemløser med tidligere teknisk bakgrunn. Du må kunne jobbe både selvstendig og i team, være løsningsorientert og samarbeidsvillig. Stillingen krever at du er strukturert. Det er en selvstendig, variert og utfordrende stilling.

Krav

  • Teknisk innsikt, gjerne erfaring fra anleggmaskiner eller landbruksutstyr
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Beherske et skandinavisk språk

Meritterende

  • Scooterførekort
  • Kunnskap innen hydraulikk og mobilelektro
  • Fagbrev som mekaniker
  • Relevant erfaring innen flere felt fra et alpinanlegg er meritterende
  • Interesse for digital dokumentasjon

Ansettelseform
Vi søker to mekanikere; den ene stillingen er en fast stilling på 100 %, og den andre er en vikarstilling med mulighet for fast jobb senere.

Start umiddelbart eller etter avtale. Vi har 3 mnd. prøvetid.

Arbeidstider
Varierende arbeidstid med turnus. Kvelds og helgearbeid vil forekomme.

Intervjuer gjennomføres fortløpende og stillingen kan fylles før fristen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Att få jobba med minnesvärda fjällupplevelser året runt tycker vi är det bästa som finns!

Vår personal är vår absolut största tillgång. Ett gemensamt engagemang och en strävan efter att skapa en bra fjällupplevelse för våra gäster är en stor del av vår framgång. Hos oss kan du vara dig själv och ha kul, samtidigt som du levererar ett betydande resultat tillsammans med fantastiska kollegor.

På SkiStar är vi fler än 700 helårsanställda som tillsammans jobbar med bland annat försäljning, ekonomi, drift, aktiviteter, It, administration, logiförmedling, fastighetsservice och marknadsföring. Under vintersäsong har vi dessutom över 2700 säsongsanställda.

jobs.title: Welders, Southern Finland
jobs.description:

We are currently looking for skilled welders for several locations, including Raasepori, Vihti, Karkkila and Lohja.

Welding experience:
Previous professional experience in TIG and/or MIG/MAG welding. Experience working with materials such as stainless steel, aluminium and carbon steel is considered an advantage.

Ability to read technical drawings:
You should be able to interpret technical drawings and work independently according to the provided specifications.

Language skills:
You must be able to communicate in Finnish, Swedish or English.

Quality-focused attitude:
We value a proactive and responsible approach to work, attention to detail and a strong commitment to occupational safety and quality.

Right to work in Finland:
Applicants must have a valid residence permit or other valid right to work in Finland.

Welding test:
Before starting employment, the selected candidates must successfully complete a welding test.

Seen as an advantage:
Valid welding certifications with FM1 and FM5 elements are seen as an advantage.

What we offer:

Competitive salary:
Your salary will be determined based on your professional skills, experience and the requirements of the position.

Career development opportunities:
Many of our positions offer the possibility of long-term employment and permanent career opportunities.

Diverse and challenging projects:
You will have the opportunity to work on varied projects and further develop your professional welding skills.

Assistance with accommodation:
Wellpack can help you find suitable accommodation near the workplace. We can also assist with practical arrangements related to relocation.

Excellent working conditions:
You will work in a safe and supportive environment as part of a professional and friendly team.

Ready to join us?

Take the next step in your welding career and become part of our skilled team in Southern Finland!

Submit your application through our recruitment system and tell us about your welding experience, preferred location and the type of position you are looking for. Any questions can be directed to wellpack@wellpack.fi

jobs.title: Vil du ha en sosial og variert BPA-jobb i Ski? Kanskje du er min nye assistent!
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD OSLO OG ROMERIKE
jobs.description:
Som en sosial 35-åring består hverdagen min av alt fra trening, reiser og frivillig arbeid til de mer vanlige gjøremålene som handling, matlaging og husarbeid. Rullestolen er mitt fremkomstmiddel, og jeg søker nå en BPA-assistent som vil være en del av en variert hverdag der ingen dager er like.

Personlighet og god kjemi betyr mer for meg enn erfaring. Jeg setter pris på deg som er positiv, tar initiativ og liker å ha det trivelig på jobb - enten vi planlegger i forkant eller tar ting som det kommer.

Jeg søker nå:

  • En fast BPA-assistent i ca. 8 timer per uke (med gode muligheter for flere timer)
  • Tilkallingsvikarer ved behov

Hva skal vi gjøre sammen?

  • Livstil: Alt fra trening og turer i skogen til spontane aktiviteter
  • Sosiale aktiviteter: Kino, restaurantbesøk, møter og hyggelige sammenkomster
  • Rolig modus: Av og til blir det en rolig dag hjemme, enten vi lager god mat eller slapper av med en film
  • Praktiske oppgaver: Husarbeid, hjelp i butikken og de vanlige gjøremålene rundt et hjem

Hvem ser jeg etter?

  • Du er selvgående og liker å finne gode løsninger
  • Du har praktisk sans og trives med varierte oppgaver
  • Du har mulighet til å jobbe enkelte ukedager, helger og i ferieperioder etter nærmere avtale

Krav:

  • Over 18 år
  • Snakker og skriver godt norsk
  • Førerkort klasse B er en fordel

Hva får du?

  • Full opplæring fra dag én
  • Fleksible og varierte arbeidsdager
  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg faglig og personlig
  • Et arbeid hvor du får bruke deg selv - ikke bare følge en bruksanvisning
  • Lønn etter gjeldende BPA-tariff

Praktisk informasjon

  • Arbeidsted: Sentralt i Ski, med enkelt tilgang via buss og tog
  • Vandel: Plettfri vandel og politiattest kreves
  • Arbeidstid: Fleksibel etter avtale (eksempelvis ukedager fra lø. 12:00-20:00)

Tror du vi matcher? Da vil jeg gjerne høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: IT Security Specialist to Bonava in Stockholm
jobs.description:
Lead and develop IT security at Bonava in Stockholm. Work with Azure, Microsoft 365 and cybersecurity in a cloud-first environment

At Bonava, we are not only building houses, we are also creating homes and neighborhoods where people live their lives. To keep our digital world safe, we´re now looking for an IT Security Specialist to lead and develop our cybersecurity landscape.This is a broad role where you will combine strategic vision with hands-on expertise. You will work closely with colleagues across infrastructure, governance and operations to strengthen our security posture, drive continuous improvement and ensure our cloud-first environment remains secure, compliant and resilient.If you are motivated by taking ownership, influencing security strategies and working with modern Microsoft technologies in a business-critical environment, this is an opportunity to make a real impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

At Bonava, you will have the opportunity to shape how we protect our systems, services and data moving forward. You will join an organization where security is an important enabler for the business and where your expertise will influence both strategy and operations.

You will have the opportunity to:

    Take overall responsibility for IT security across Bonava
    Work in a cloud-first environment built primarily on Microsoft Azure
    Influence and develop security frameworks, processes and ways of working
    Combine strategic security initiatives with hands-on technical work
    Collaborate with stakeholders across IT and the wider business
    Enjoy a flexible hybrid working model from our central Stockholm office

Your Challenge

As IT Security Specialist, you will take overall responsibility for IT security at Bonava. This is a broad role where you will work closely with both technical teams and business stakeholders to continuously strengthen the organization’s security posture.

You will:

    Strengthen and maintain security across Bonava’s systems and data
    Monitor the threat landscape and initiate preventive measures
    Manage and develop security infrastructure
    Educate users and promote a strong security culture across the organization
    Drive improvement initiatives related to security and compliance
    Provide informed guidance to management on security risks, incidents and strategic priorities to enhance the organization’s security posture

The Team and Workplace

You will be part of the IT Infrastructure and Compliance team, working alongside colleagues within infrastructure, governance and operations.

Bonava operates with a cloud-first IT strategy, primarily leveraging Microsoft Azure. While the focus is on modern cloud-based solutions, the environment remains hybrid, with certain systems and services still managed on- premises.

The position is based in central Stockholm and offers a hybrid work model with flexibility to work from home.

About You

We believe you will thrive in this role if you have a few years of experience within IT Security or Infrastructure and enjoy working in an environment where strategic thinking and hands-on problem-solving go hand in hand.

You also have:

    Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Security tools, like Defender, Intune and Sentinel
    Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender, Intune and automation
    Understanding of Azure environments and hybrid setups
    Understanding of network security principles
     Experience working with enterprise network environments
    Skills in scripting, preferably PowerShell or Python
    A proactive, structured and responsible approach
    Excellent communication skills in English

As a person, you are collaborative and take initiative to move your work forward. You are a clear and confident communicator who builds trust with stakeholders across the organization. You exercise good judgement, stay up to date with developments in the cybersecurity landscape and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex challenges.

It is considered a plus if you have experience working with governance, risk and compliance frameworks, as well as log management and analysis. Swedish language skills are also considered an advantage.

Let´s Connect!

We have chosen to work with Ada Digital in this hiring process. Their recruitment process focuses on transparency, inclusion and a fast moving candidate experience. And now we want to know more about you – on your own terms! To apply, please fill out the short form, briefly motivate why you are interested in the position, and attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile. No additional documentation is needed. You can then, in real-time, follow your application online as our recruiters are working with it. We work with a continues selection process which means we might hire a candidate before the final apply date, so apply already today! Interested and want to know more? Please contact our recruiter today.  We are looking forward to connecting soon!

jobs.title: Taxi Driver Espoo
jobs.description:
Taxi driving experience is an advantage but not required. The task suits both experienced drivers and those who want to learn the profession.

LETS RIDE
* Get behind the wheel with Taksi Helsinki Finlands most popular operator. Bolt and Uber options are also available.
* You drive a Tesla Model Y.
* Day and night shifts are available. Shifts can be planned a month in advance, we only confirm vehicle availability.
* We operate on a commission model. The drivers fee is 45% of rides (VAT 0%).

BASICS WILL DO
* To drive a taxi, you need a driving licence (B) issued in Finland or another EU/EEA country at least one year ago.
* We expect Finnish at a sufficient conversational level; perfect grammar is not required. English or other languages are a plus.
* Reliability and a service-minded attitude are important.

360° SUPPORT
* Youve got or youre ready to get a taxi drivers licence (taksinkuljettajan ajolupa) soon. If needed, the prep materials are right there on the table.
* Moving from another location? Well help you with housing search and support you through the process.
* Support with practical matters and paperwork at the start.

Different people. New places. Freedom to choose. If this sounds like you lets ride!

Aria’s Modular Homes Limited is seeking an experienced, qualified Plumber to support residential extensions, attic conversions and modular-home installations. jobs.title: Project SCM Specialist
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Join HVDC as a Project SCM Specialist!

Bring your expertise to our innovative team at Hitachi Energy and help create a greener future with world-leading technology. HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) develops and sells DC transmission systems globally, used for long-distance electricity transmission and submarine cables.

As part of our Global Supply Chain Management, you'll contribute to major infrastructure projects worldwide, working closely with end customers and enjoying vast career opportunities. If you thrive on complex projects and have a problem-solving and curious mindset, this role is for you!

We value diversity and collaboration, ensuring everyone feels respected and included. Join us and make a difference! #diversity #genderequity #inclusion.

How you’ll make an impact:

    As Project SCM Specialist you will be the focal point between HVDC and our suppliers during the execution phase of our projects.
    You will work closely with Project SCM Managers, Logistic Planners, Engineers, Documentation Control and Suppliers follow up and secure that the equipment and documentation deliveries from our Suppliers is according to agreed time, cost and quality.
    You work in a team with other Project SCM Specialists and will take on equipment’s or project responsibility.
    During the project execution you need to ensure relentless execution with proactive planning and follow-up on all equipment deliveries with our suppliers and internal stakeholders.
    During project execution you will also drive, attend and provide information to kick-off and clarification meetings with suppliers.
    You will work closely with the Project SCM Manager to solve upcoming quality constraints or deficiencies with the supplier equipment deliveries.
    Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your Background

    You have an academic degree in a relevant field: Supply Chain Management, Business & Administration, or Engineering (or equivalent work experience).
    Preferably you have 2-3 years of professional experience working in close interaction with suppliers and have practice stakeholder management to some extent.
    You should also have the ability to stay structured and organized even under pressure and when dealing with many tasks and stakeholders in parallel.
    Enjoy working in project-based environments and collaborating with people from different functions, educational backgrounds, and cultures.
    Excellent written and spoken English skills, as the role involves working in a global organization with international suppliers.
    Strong communication and relationship-building skills are required in this role.
    On a personal level, you are a collaborative and reliable team player with an independent and results oriented working style.

Additional information

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

This is a hybrid position where you will be based at the Ludvika Hitachi Energy office, with the possibility of working from home up to a couple times per week.

More About Us​​

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
    Health care and wellness allowance ​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
    Psychological support program ​

jobs.title: People & Production Manager - Assembly & Delivery
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead a major production organisation and play a key role in shaping the future of one of Sweden's leading manufacturing businesses? At DOVISTA, you'll have the opportunity to drive operational excellence, develop leaders and make a lasting impact in an international industrial environment.

<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/4aa67c38-b348-4a74-81f8-9b8225ef9e06.jpg">

Your Opportunity

We are looking for a strong people and operations manager to take responsibility for our Assembly & Delivery operations, a critical part of our window manufacturing business. Leading approximately 200 employees through a team of six first-line managers and two process developers, you will play a key role in driving performance, strengthening the organisation and ensuring operational excellence across the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to take responsibility for a large production area and make a significant impact on people, culture and operational performance. Whether you currently manage a production department, a manufacturing unit, or a sizeable operational team, you are motivated by driving results through others and developing strong leadership teams.

You will work closely with our Senior Director, Head of Operations Sweden, and be part of the production management team, contributing to both strategic direction and operational execution. This is a visible leadership position with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on people, performance and culture. With around 600 colleagues at our Edsbyn site, you'll join a growing team in a company that's shaping the future.

Who You Are

You have a solid background in manufacturing or industrial operations and a track record of creating results through people, structure and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking responsibility for a larger operation, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability at all levels of the organisation. Just as important, you know how to engage people, develop talent and build a culture where performance and collaboration go hand in hand.

We believe you have:

    Proven experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Experience building strong teams and creating results through others
    A track record of driving operational improvements and delivering results
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    A university degree in engineering, production, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through a successful leadership career in manufacturing.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    To be considered for this position, you must hold a permanent work permit in Sweden.

Why Edsbyn?

Choosing to live and work in Edsbyn means embracing balance. You'll find proximity to nature, space for family life, and a welcoming community - all while making a real impact in a globally connected business. For the right person, this role offers a rare combination of significant leadership responsibility, long-term career opportunities, and a high quality of life in one of Sweden's most scenic regions.

Application



This recruitment is managed in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Consultant Marjo Carlson at +46 70 377 06 64 or marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background, experience, and qualifications make you a strong fit for the role.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-09-23. Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

About DOVISTA

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people's everyday lives.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

About DOVISTA Sweden

DOVISTA Sweden brings together well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds Fönster, and VELFAC with local experts within a strong international group.

With approximately 700 employees, we are one of Sweden's leading window manufacturers. Together, we develop sustainable, high-quality solutions with a focus on our customers and the future.

jobs.title: Vikariat som rettleiar ved Nav Giske
jobs.description:
Vi søkjer rettleiarar som ønskjer å vere med å løyse Nav sitt viktige samfunnsoppdrag!

Nav Giske har eit ledig vikariat i 100% stilling. Vikariatet er ledig omgående og gjeld til 31.10.2027.  

Som rettleiar hos oss vil ein viktig del av jobben vere å motivere og hjelpe brukarar til å finne jobbmoglegheiter og aktuelle tiltak for å kome i eller stå i arbeid. Arbeidet inneber også saksbehandling og forvaltningsoppgåver etter ulike lovverk. Stillinga omfattar både kommunale og statlege oppgåver, og alle tilsette deltek i  bemanning av publikumsmottaket.

Nav Giske består av 15 engasjerte medarbeidarar og eit godt fagmiljø. Verksemda er utviklingsorientert med høge ambisjonar, og vi legg stor vekt på brukarmedverknad og samhandling. Gjennom innsatsen vår får fleire moglegheit til å vere i arbeid, delta i samfunnet og sikre eiga inntekt. Vi tilbyr tenester til kommunen sine om lag 8 800 innbyggjarar og er ein innovativ og framtidsretta tenesteleverandør. Gjennom brukarmedverknad, samhandling og eit sterkt kompetansemiljø skal vi bidra til å hindre utanforskap, få fleire i arbeid og sikre ein velfungerande arbeidsmarknad.

I tillegg til formell kompetanse blir det lagt vekt på motivasjon, personlege eigenskapar og at ein ellers er skikka for stillinga.

Dokumentasjon på utdanning og praksis skal sendast inn i lag med søknaden.

 


Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Heilskapleg arbeidsretta oppfølging av brukarar
  • Saksbehandling etter relevant lovverk innafor Nav sine kommunale og statlege ansvarsområde
  • Oppfølging, rettleiing og motivering av brukarar med fokus på arbeid, meistring og inkludering i arbeidslivet
  • Gi råd og rettleiing, også innan privatøkonomi
  • Byggje gode relasjonar og samarbeide med næringsliv og andre aktuelle samarbeidspartnarar
  • Delta i kontoret sine fellesoppgåver 

Nav-kontoret er i stadig endring og utvikling, og ein må rekne med endringar i arbeidsoppgåver ut frå hehov. 

Kvalifikasjonar
  • Fullført utdanning på minimum bachelornivå, gjerne innan helse- og sosialfag eller samfunnsfag. Særleg relevant arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet.
  • Rettleiingskompetanse frå studiar og/eller praksis
  • Gode norskkunnskapar både munnleg og skriftleg, minimum nivå B2
  • God digital kompetanse og evne til å raskt setje deg inn i nye fagsystem
  • God relasjonskompetanse

 

Det er i tillegg ønskeleg at du har:

  • Forståing av Nav si rolle i samfunnet
  • Grunnleggjande økonomisk forståing/privatøkonomi
  • Erfaring frå tverrfagleg samarbeid
  • Kjennskap til næringslivet og kunnskap om arbeidsmarknaden i vårt område
  • Erfaring frå saksbehandling og tolking av lovverk, gjerne frå offentleg forvaltning
  • Førarkort klasse B
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Du er ein relasjonsbyggar som evnar å skape tillit, kontakt og motivasjon hos brukarar i vanskelege livssituasjonar
  • Du er ein trygg og tydeleg rettleiar som tør å utfordre og evner å gjennomføre
  • Du arbeider resultatorientert og er oppteken av kvalitet
  • Du bidreg til eit godt og utviklande arbeidsmiljø
  • Du arbeider sjølvstendig, målretta og strukturert
  • Du evner å sjå heilskap og handtere eit breitt spekter av oppgåver
  • Personlege eigenskapar og erfaring med arbeid i Nav vil bli vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Spennande og meiningsfylte arbeidsoppgåver innan eit viktig samfunnsområde
  • Eit sterkt fagmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer
  • Fagleg og personleg utvikling
  • Fleksitidsordning
  • Løn og tilsetjing på kommunale vilkår
KontaktinformasjonTone Mette Lorgen Johnsen, leiar Nav Giske, +47 95872214
ArbeidsstadValderhaug 4
6050 Valderøya
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Giske kommune

Referansenr.: 5173381565
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Vikar
Startdato: 01.10.2026
Sluttdato: 31.10.2027
Søknadsfrist: 15.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Giske kommune har om lag 8828 innbyggjarar på øyane Vigra, Valderøya, Giske og Godøya. Ålesund Lufthavn ligg i kommunen. Øyane er knytt saman og har fastlandsamband til Ålesund. Kommunen byr på eit særprega kystmiljø med storslått natur, dugnadsånd, festivalar, variert kulturtilbod og gode høve til friluftsliv. Kommunen har høg vekst i folketal og sterk næringsutvikling, og er blant landets største fiskerikommuner. Kommunen er ein attraktiv stad å bu og arbeide, og har ein høg andel barn og unge.

jobs.title: Teamkoordinator
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om en hverdag som social- og sundhedsassistent der er præget af nærvær og samarbejde, med mulig for administrativt arbejde som teamkoordinator.

Frit Valg Svane Pleje søger lige nu en social og sundhedsassistent stilling til hjemmepleje i vores afdeling i Nørresundby.

Vi har gennem den seneste tid gennemgået en rivende udvikling i vores arbejdsgange i forhold til Implementering af den nye ældre reform – til gavn for kollegaer og borgere. Vi er kommet en lang vej og ønsker at fortsætte den gode udvikling. I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi i teams på tværs af hele døgnet for at styrke samarbejdet kollegaer imellem og skabe den helt rigtige opmærksomhed og sparring på vores borgeres forløb og pleje. Teamkoordinator funktionen giver mulighed for at være bindeled mellem plejen og din planlægger. Arbejdet består primært af administrative opgaver og faglig sparring med kollegaer.

Vi søger en kollega, der ønsker at tage del i denne udvikling og yde den bedste pleje til vores borgere. Vi tilbyder en fast stilling til vores dagvagtteam med rig mulighed for indflydelse på egne arbejdstider, og udvikling af arbejdsområder samt kollegial sparring.

Opgaverne som social- og sundhedsassistent er mangeartede, men overordnet kan nævnes:

  • Er på kontoret hele dagen, køre ud i marken i akutte situationer.

  • Bindeled mellem kollegaer og planlægger.

  • Telefonpasning hele dagen.

  • Håndtere nødkalds telefonen + sætte besøg på planerne. (registrere tilstand på borgerne og være opfølgende på ekstraaftalerne)

  • Optimering af planer/aflysninger.

  • Vagtdækning.

  • Håndtere sygdom i hverdagene kl. 6,30, et team ad gangen på skift hver 3. uge.

  • Holde Quinyx opdateret ved vagtændringer.

  • Tidlig opsporing – tage ud til borgere ved behov.

  • Superbruger i Cura og skærmenhed.

  • Orientere sig i Cura – indlagt/aflysninger/ekstra aftaler/ændringer i visitationen.

  • Teammøder – i samarbejde med planlægger & fagligleder

 

Vil du med på holdet?

Vi søger dig, der er uddannet social og sundhedsassistent og som brænder for at arbejde med borgere i eget hjem, der gennem helhjertet og professionel indsats vil gøre en stor forskel for vores borgeres hverdag og trivsel.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at:

·         Du har et kæmpe omsorgsgen, som du ønsker at sætte i spil i en stilling

·         Er i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et tværfagligt team

·         Kan agere professionelt og udvise stor tålmodighed og forståelse for menneskers situation

·         Du er dygtig til at kommunikere og arbejde tværprofessionelt

·         Du kan skabe tryghed og liv gennem nærvær og dialog

·         Du er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

·         Du er omstillingsparat, da opgaverne er omskiftelige og det daglige arbejde kræver fleksibilitet

Vi kan tilbyde:

·         En fast stilling på 35 timer – ansvarshavende SSA hver 4 weekend fra kl. 6-15

·         Et grundigt introduktionsforløb, hvor du kører sammen med en kollega den første tid og bliver oplært i vores systemer

·         Stor frihed under ansvar

·         Muligheden for kompetenceudvikling og kollegial sparring

·         En lydhør ledelse, der forstår at den enkelte medarbejder er en stærk ressource

 

Sammen skaber vi gode rammer for din ansættelse
Dit primære arbejdssted er i Nørresundby, hvor du møder ind og hvis der er behov for at hjælpe i plejen, så er der på adressen er der mulighed for at låne en af vores firmabiler/ el cykler, som står til rådighed.

Ansøgning og ansættelsesforhold
Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt eller efter nærmere aftale. Der indkaldes til samtale i uge 39.Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker stillingsopslaget uddybet, er du velkommen til at kontakte dagligleder Jannike Frølund på +41 40 20 10 eller på e-mailadressen aalborg@svanepleje.dk

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

jobs.title: Linux Build System Engineer, Lund
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be part of a Platform Engineering team serving 900 developers with an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) which automates what is required to build, test and release AXIS OS, the embedded Linux distribution that powers our products? If you are passionate about large scale build systems and are looking for the possibility to work with like-minded professionals, then this can be the perfect opportunity for you!

Your future team
You will be part of a growing Platform Engineering organization, divided into small, highly collaborative, and autonomous sub-teams. Together with your future colleagues you provide an Internal Developer Platform that is used by Axis developers to create daily releases of AXIS OS, used in over 200 different Axis products. The IDP is built with a mix of open-source software, internally developed tools, and vendor licensed software. We're active in several open-source communities and you're encouraged to contribute to and engage with them. We also embrace AI to work smarter, using AI-assisted development and automation to speed up our daily work and free up time for the problems that matter most.

You and your teammates own the sub-team backlog, and you are responsible for the evolution of your area of responsibility. You are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies, and your teammates will be available for feedback and support. We are great at what we do, and we are sure you will be inspired by our drive to always improve and learn more. The products you will work on are used by AXIS OS developers every day and you will be challenged and learn much from working close with them to improve how they work, day to day.

Our culture is characterized by openness, trust, and collaboration. Work/life balance and hanging out with your teammates at common fikas, lunches, and other social activities are important to us and our success. Like the rest of Axis, we don't let ourselves get stuck in rigid processes. Rather, we rely on the Axis Act As One spirit and work closely to achieve our shared goals.

What will you do as a Yocto build system engineer?
You will join a team of senior developers focusing on developing and maintaining our Yocto based build system. Yocto is the open-source framework we use to build, customize, and maintain the Linux distribution that becomes AXIS OS. A key selling point for Axis devices is that we run the same operating system, AXIS OS, in all our devices, easing integration in customer and partner systems. You will work in close collaboration with AXIS OS developers to understand their needs and pain points and how the build system can support them in their daily work-life.

This will give you an idea of what you'll be working on:

    Introduce and establish the use of new features that are introduced by the Yocto project
    Keep AXIS OS updated with Poky releases from Yocto
    Improve Cyber and Supply chain security
    Work in close cooperation with AXIS OS developers to understand their needs and how we can help them by improving our tools and services
    Identify and resolve technical challenges such as reproducibility, caching, structure of recipes and packages in a build system that is used by 900 developers
    Take an active interest in how we collaborate, both within the team and across R&D Tools and Axis as a whole
    Contribute to Yocto and other open-source projects.
    Use AI-powered tools to increase efficiency in the build system, from automating repetitive tasks to speeding up testing and code reviews

Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We are looking for an open, creative, and pragmatic problem solver that likes to combine long-term thinking and structure with the here and now that naturally follows from working closely with users. You are motivated by new challenges and are eager to learn, but you also get energy from helping others grow by sharing your knowledge. Like us, you value teamwork and want to contribute to our great team spirit. We're also looking for someone with a genuine interest in team dynamics, someone who gets energy from helping a team collaborate better and take shared responsibility for the bigger picture, alongside the hands-on development work.

We would love to hear that you have:

    University degree in Computer Science or similar
    Professional experience from working with Linux build systems
    Solid understanding of software development process and life cycle with focus on Continuous Integration (CI)
    Extensive, hands-on experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash
    A genuine interest in team dynamics, you get energy from helping a team collaborate better, share responsibility, and grow more autonomous

The following qualifications are a plus:

    Hands-on experience from working with Yocto/BitBake/OpenEmbedded
    Experience of open-source contribution
    An understanding of embedded development
    Experience with git and code review tools, e.g. Gerrit

What Axis has to offer!
At Axis you will be able to grow as a developer and use your creativity to experiment and from time to time make mistakes that can be a valuable source of new knowledge. Working with the Internal Developer Platform you will get immediate user feedback. You will work closely with experienced experts, developers and testers that love to overcome technical challenges together. Our culture is characterized by openness, trust, and collaboration. Finally, check out Engineering at Axis to get an insight into who we are.

Ready to Act?
Find out more from our recruiting manager Håkan Rick at 0733 35 90 23. We're looking forward to reading your application!

jobs.title: Vauvauinnin ja uimakoulun ohjaaja, Tampere
jobs.description:
Oletko työtä pelkäämätön, ihmisten kanssa toimeen tuleva ja liikunnallinen? Pidätkö lapsista? Sinulla on myös rohkeaa asennetta tarttua asioihin. Työ meillä vaatii tekijältään vastuuntuntoista asennetta ja rohkeutta tarttua toimeen. Haemme vauvauinninohjaajia ja uimaopettajia Tampereelle Uimakoulu Pikku Joutseneen. Kyseessä on ohjaustyö tarpeen mukaa. Valitsemme ensisijaisesti henkilöitä, jotka voivat ohjata arki-iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin ja kouluttautua loka-marraskuun aikana.

Kelluta Oy kehittää ja toteuttaa vauvauinti- ja uimakoulupalveluja. Meillä on vahva vesiliikunnan ammattilaisten kouluttamisen taustaosaaminen ja koulutamme säännöllisesti alan ammattilaisia niin Suomessa kuin ulkomaillakin.

Olemme alan edelläkävijä ja siksi haluamme taloomme alan parhaat tekijät. Tarjolla on haasteellinen, luova työ ja kilpailukykyinen palkka. Koulutamme tarvittaessa, eli työtä voi hakea, vaikka ei ole vielä esimerkiksi uimaopettaja tai vauva- ja perheuinninohjaajakoulutusta. Työ vaatii täysi-ikäisyyden.

Edellytämme valmiutta kouluttautua konseptimme mukaiseksi ohjaajaksi. Suomalainen Vesiliikuntainstituutti tarjoaa Vauvauinninohjaaja- ja uimaopettajavalmennuksen tehtävään valituille. Eduksi katsotaan uimaopettajan tutkinto (Suomen Uimaopetus- ja hengenpelastusliitto ry, SUH tai vastaava koulutus) ja/tai Vauva- ja perheuinninohjaajakurssi (Suomen Uimaopetus- ja hengenpelastusliitto ry, SUH tai vastaava koulutus).

Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana.

jobs.title: Kokki Break Sokos Hotel Bomballe
jobs.description:
Primary location:
NURMES

Kokki Break Sokos Hotel Bomballe

Huikaisevan kauniin Pielisen rannalla Pohjois-Karjalassa sijaitseva Bomba on ainutlaatuinen ja omaperäinen matkailukohde ympäri vuoden. Bomban uudestisyntynyt kylpylähotelli hellii jokaista aistia. Haluaisimme saada sinut mukaan rakentamaan omalla työpanoksellasi elämyksiä asiakkaillemme.

Haetaan kiireestä syttyvää sekä monipuolisesta työnkuvasta nauttivaa kokkia osaksi Bomban keittiötiimiä. A'la cartesta aamiaiseen, kokouksesta cateringiin ja kaikkea maan sekä taivaan väliltä on luvassa ainutlaatuisessa matkailukohteessa Pielisen rannalla. Sinulla tulee olla kokin koulutus tai aikaisempi työkokemus ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä. Odotamme, että olet oma-aloitteinen, paineensietokykyinen ja tehokas henkilö. Sinä haluat sekä kehittyä omassa työssäsi ja kehittää työyhteisön toimintaa. Arvostat hyvää ruokaa ja ensiluokkaista asiakaskokemusta. Hygieniapassi vaaditaan.

Työtehtävä on vakituinen ja tunteja tarjoamme sinulle 75 h / 3 vk. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi. jobs.title: Sauda kommune, avdeling Nav søker
jobs.description:
Er du en person med pågangsmot og engasjement, som ønsker å bidra til økt inkludering i arbeidslivet? Er du en relasjonsbygger som er opptatt av å skape gode løsninger sammen? Da kan du være vår nye veileder.

Nav Sauda har 8 engasjerte veiledere og søker nå en 100% veileder til fast stilling. Vi ser etter deg som har tro på den enkeltes muligheter, som er opptatt av arbeidsinkludering og som evner å kombinere relasjonskompetanse med struktur og målrettet oppfølging. Summen av dette gir innbyggere og arbeidsgivere gode tjenester.

Arbeids- og ansvarsoppgaver 
  • Kartlegging av brukere/innbyggere og avklaring av hvilken form for bistand disse kan få hos Nav
  • Saksbehandling på ulike fagområder. Vurdere og følge opp vilkår knyttet til aktuelt lovverk, samt innhenting av nødvendig dokumentasjon
  • Helhetlig veiledning og arbeidsrettet oppfølging av personer som av ulike årsaker står utenfor arbeidslivet, med mål om arbeid
  • Utadrettet kontakt med bedrifter og organisasjoner med mål om samarbeid som skaper muligheter for innbyggerne våre.
  • Initiere og koordinere samarbeid med aktuelle aktører som behandlere, tiltaksarrangører, arbeidsgivere m.fl.
  • Tett samarbeid med andre ansatte på kontoret for å sørge for god overgang til arbeid og aktivitet
  • Betjene vertsfunksjon i kontorets åpningstid for publikum
  • Andre arbeidsoppgaver etter behov
Kvalifikasjoner 
  • 3-årig høgskole-/universitetsutdanning innen sosialt arbeid, arbeids- og velferdsfag, samfunnsfag eller andre relevante fagområder.
  • Kompetanse og/eller erfaring med saksbehandling, veiledning og relasjonsarbeid.
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter i norsk, muntlig og skriftlig, samt beherske engelsk muntlig og skriftlig. Søkere uten norsk som morsmål må kunne dokumentere bestått norskopplæring på minimum nivå B2.
  • God brukerkompetanse på relevante IT-verktøy, samt evne til raskt å sette seg inn i nye datasystemer.
Det er også en fordel om du har: 
  • Erfaring fra Nav og/eller offentlig sektor 
  • Erfaring fra arbeidsrettet oppfølging og kunnskap om arbeidsmarkedet 
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter en deg som liker utfordringer og engasjerer deg i møte med mennesker i ulike livssituasjoner. Du er god til å prioritere og samarbeider naturlig med kollegaer og andre samarbeidspartnere i saker. Du ser at kontoret har et felles ansvar for oppfølging og er opptatt av brukers og samfunnets beste, på tvers av ansvarsområder. Du tar ansvar, jobber strukturert og målrettet. Du har gjennomføringsevne og jobber selvstendig, er positiv og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Personlig egenskaper vil bli vektlag.

Vi kan tilby
  • En spennende stilling med faglige utfordringer 
  • Fleksitidsordning
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
Ansettelsesvilkår

Ansettelsen skjer på de vilkår og med de plikter som følger av gjeldende lovverk, reglement og tariffavtale for Sauda kommune. Ved ansettelse vil vi kreve godkjent politiattest. Sauda kommune oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke stillingen i kommunen, uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonshemming, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn.

Søknad sendes

Sauda kommune benytter elektronisk søknadsprosess. Vi ber derfor alle å søke via elektroniske søknadssystem. Dersom du har behov for hjelp med registrering av søknad, ta kontakt med lønningskontoret på mail lonn@sauda.kommune.no eller på telefon 52 78 62 00.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren ber om å ikke bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlista. Dersom du oppgir begrunnelse om å unntas fra offentligheten i din søknad, og anmodningen ikke tas til følge, vil søker bli informert, jf. offentlighetslovens §25.

Velkommen som søker! 

Les mer om å jobbe, bo og leve i Sauda her: https://visitsauda.no/ny-i-sauda/


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sauda kommune ligger i vakre Ryfylke og har 4600 innbyggere. Historisk er Sauda mest kjent som en vannkraft- og industrikommune, men vi har et variert og innholdsrikt næringsliv. Sauda er en kompakt småby med nærhet til "alt". Vi har jobbmuligheter, tomter, servicefunksjoner, gode skoler, rikelig med barnehageplasser og er omgitt av fantastisk natur. For mer informasjon se: www.portalsauda.no

jobs.title: Experienced Security Tools Engineer - Static Code Analysis, Lund
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be part of a Platform Engineering team that provides 900 developers with an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that helps secure AXIS OS, the embedded Linux distribution that powers our products? This is an area where Axis is actively expanding, with continued investment that reflects its strategic importance to our product portfolio.

As part of our security tooling sub-team, you will play a key role in static code analysis, today centered on Coverity, and help AXIS OS developers use it to find and fix vulnerabilities before they ship. The long-term ambition is to grow this into a broader static code analysis ecosystem over time. If you are passionate about application security and static analysis and are looking for the possibility to work with like-minded professionals, then this can be the perfect opportunity for you!

Your future team
You will be part of a growing Platform Engineering team, divided into small, highly collaborative, and autonomous sub-teams. You will join our security tooling sub-team, responsible for the security-related tooling including vulnerability scanning and management, supply chain evaluation, and static code analysis. The IDP is built with a mix of open-source software, internally developed tools, and vendor licensed software. We're active in several open-source communities and you're encouraged to contribute to and engage with them.

You and your teammates own the sub-team backlog, and you are responsible for the evolution of your area of responsibility. You are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies, and your teammates will be available for feedback and support. We are great at what we do, and we are sure you will be inspired by our drive to always improve and learn more. The tools you will work on are used by AXIS OS developers every day and you will be challenged and learn much from working close with them to improve how the work, day to day.

Our culture is characterized by openness, trust, and collaboration. Work/life balance and hanging out with your teammates at common fikas, lunches, and other social activities are important to us and our success. Like the rest of Axis, we don't let ourselves get stuck in rigid processes. Rather, we rely on the Axis Act As One spirit and work closely to achieve our shared goals.

What will you do as a security tools engineer?
You will join our security tooling sub-team. Your initial focus will be on strengthening our work with Coverity, our static code analysis service, while also taking part in the sub-team's broader work. You will work in close collaboration with AXIS OS developers to understand their needs and pain points and how static analysis can support them in their daily work, as well as support the use of Coverity for compliance purposes.

This will give you an idea of what you'll be working on:

    Configure and refine Coverity's static analysis capabilities to keep them effective for AXIS OS developers
    Support AXIS OS developers in how to use static code analysis effectively to find and resolve vulnerabilities and quality issues
    Work closely with AXIS OS product management to ensure that the Coverity setup supports compliance needs
    Work in close cooperation with AXIS OS developers to understand their needs and how we can help them by improving our tools and services
    Evaluate and introduce new features and capabilities related to static code analysis
    Collaborate with the rest of the security tooling team on vulnerability scanning, supply chain evaluation, and other security tooling initiatives
    Align with other area experts across the larger Platform Engineering team to share knowledge and make sure our tools and services fit into the bigger picture

Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We are looking for an open, creative, and pragmatic problem solver that likes to combine long-term thinking and structure with the here and now that naturally follows from working closely with users. You are motivated by new challenges and are eager to learn, but you also get energy from helping others grow by sharing your knowledge. Like us, you value teamwork and want to contribute to our great team spirit. You have a security mindset and enjoy digging into how tools and processes can help developers write more secure, higher quality code.

We would love to hear that you have:

    University degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification
    Professional experience with software development, with a genuine interest in application security and code quality
    Solid understanding of software development process and life cycle with focus on Continuous Integration (CI)
    Hands-on experience with static code analysis tools, e.g. Coverity, SonarQube, or similar
    Knowledge of C and C++ development, secure coding practices, and standards such as CERT C/C++ or MISRA C
    Experience with vulnerability management, supply chain security, or compliance work, e.g. the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) or ISO 27001
    An understanding of embedded development
    Experience with git and code review tools, e.g. Gerrit

What Axis has to offer!
At Axis you will be able to grow as a developer and use your creativity to experiment and from time to time make mistakes that can be a valuable source of new knowledge. Working with tools that directly affect the security and quality of AXIS OS, you will get immediate feedback from the developers who rely on them. You will work closely with experienced experts, developers and testers that love to overcome technical challenges together. Our culture is characterized by openness, trust, and collaboration. Finally, check out Engineering at Axis to get an insight into who we are.

Ready to Act?
Find out more from our recruiting manager Håkan Rick at 0733 35 90 23. We're looking forward to reading your application!

jobs.title: Postdoc in material flow analysis and resource management
jobs.description:
The SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a postdoctoral position in material flow analysis and resource management. The position is initially offered for one year, with the possibility of extension depending on available funding.

The position will focus on quantitative assessment of material and resource systems. The work will involve analysis of material stocks and flows, resource use, waste management and recycling, and associated environmental impacts across different material systems and end-use sectors.

The postdoc will apply material flow analysis, life cycle assessment and scenario analysis to support research on resource and waste management. Application areas may include plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials and other material systems.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

·         Quantifying material stocks and flows across different material systems and end-use sectors

·         Assessing secondary resource availability and future resource demand

·         Applying life cycle assessment and scenario analysis

·         Contributing to scientific publications and research projects

·         Contributing to teaching and supervision within relevant areas

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

·         A PhD in environmental engineering, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field

·         Strong experience with material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, and scenario analysis

·         Strong quantitative and analytical skills

·         A strong publication record in relevant international journals

·         Experience in international research collaboration

·         Good written and spoken English

·         Ability to work independently and as part of a research team

Experience with plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials or related resource systems will be considered an advantage. 

Research environment

As a postdoc, you will conduct independent research, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy and energy system optimization.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with external partners, including international conferences and research visits.

Application

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying

  • PhD degree certificate(s)

  • A list of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

Submission guideline: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

The application deadline is 10. September 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark

Assessment and selection process

Employment terms 

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from 15 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein.  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.  

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. jobs.title: Lead Technician Los
jobs.description:
It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team!

We are hiring a new Lead Technician based for our hub in Los, Vaesternorrlands laen.

Snapshot of your day
As our Lead Technican you are responsible of the daily management & supervision of the Service technicians to ensure effective planning and execution of service, operation and warranty for turbines in your service hub area. Build a long-term perspective with the team to ensure that Siemens Gamesa delivers high performance and value to the customer.

How you can make a difference

    Perform assignments delegated by the responsible Operations Manager.
    Coordination, planning and execution of service, operation and support for assigned site or travelling technician team. Including resource planning, vacancies & work schedule in co-operation with central planning.
    Ensure safety is #1, all technicians have adequate training, safety equipment, work instructions and risk assessments before starting any work. Continuous follow up and improvement of incidents to implement improvements. Ensure site staff and subcontractors are informed and follow the agreed overall EHS procedures and site specific EHS plan in the organization.
    Utilize local and regional technical support to solve issues at the sites.
    Take corrective actions, address shortfalls, and make improvements to drive the service teams.
    Responsible for continuous development and improvement of productivity and KPI’s as well as other site / contractual goals supported by Ops Manager.
    Provide Monthly reporting to Customers and manage site monthly meetings towards the customer with the support of the Ops Mgr.
    Build the long-term perspective with the Customer as site contact and toward Suppliers to build lasting relationships.
    Managing work in varying conditions to adopt planning of works and resources to fulfil contractual obligations, optimize WF production and team productivity.
    Manage team to complete and maintain required and accurate documentation and records.
    Site administration includes reporting, handling orders, keeping records etc.

What you bring
Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change.

The ideal candidate has a technical/vocational diploma just as it is preferred that you have an electrical and/or mechanical background and experience. You have some years of experience in a leadership role.

In this role you also

    Demonstrate highly effective planning and organizational skills.
    Have the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and preferable wind turbine experience is demonstrated.
    Are able to work independently and in a team environment.
    Have fluent English skills - verbal and written. Swedish is a big advantage.
    You possess a driver’s license (B
    You must be physically in good shape and not afraid of heights, medical examination required including Swedish “mast och stolpintyg”.

If you are offered the position, you will need an approved health check and a drug test before starting your employment.



Who is Siemens Energy?
Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich heritage of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to creating sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind power industry and a manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy needs of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals who want to join our team and participate in our focus on energy transformation.



Our commitment to diversity
Fortunately, we are not all the same.

Through diversity, we generate power. We build on inclusion, and our collective creative energy is driven by multiple nationalities. We celebrate characters – regardless of ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We add energy to our environment, the entire community, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

How we empower our employees
https://www.siemensgamesa.com/sustainability/employees

How do you envision the future?
Our global team is at the forefront of tackling the climate crisis and reducing carbon emissions – the greatest challenge we face.

jobs.title: Safari- ja aktiviteettiopas
jobs.description:
Nuorgamin Lomakeskus Oy on pieni kodikas perheyritys Suomen ja EU:n pohjoisimmassa kylässä - Nuorgamissa. Lomakeskus sijaitsee upeissa avarissa tunturimaisemissa, aivan Norjan ja Jäämeren läheisyydessä, Tenojoen rannalla. Lomakeskus on toiminut jo yli 50 vuotta saman perheen käsissä. Yrityksemme tärkeitä arvoja ovat kestävä matkailu, paikallisuus ja luonto. Henkilökuntaamme kuuluu 2-8 vakituista ja kausityöntekijää omistajaperheen lisäksi. . Haemme joukkoomme safari- ja aktiviteettioppaita talvikauteen 2026-2027. Työt alkavat joulukuussa ja kestävät maaliskuun loppuun asti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Asiakasryhmämme ovat pieniä, ja haluammekin painottaa työssämme asiakkaiden aitoa kohtaamista, vieraanvaraisuutta ja henkilökohtaista palvelua. Tavoitteenamme on luoda asiakkaillemme ainutlaatuinen elämysmatka pohjoisimman Lapin arktisella tundra-alueella.

Safari- ja aktiviteettioppaana tehtäviisi kuuluu kansainvälisten viikkoasiakkaidemme ohjaaminen kelkkasafareilla, lumikenkäretkillä sekä muilla tunturiretkillä ja ulkoaktiviteeteilla. Opastöiden lisäksi työtehtäviisi kuuluu aktiviteettien valmistelu- ja purkutyöt, huoltotehtävät, eräruokailut, asiakaspalvelu sekä asiakkaiden kuljetustehtävät.

Oppaamme työskentelevät niin yhdessä, yksin kuin pareittainkin. Etsimme opasta, joka on reipas, vastuuntuntoinen tiimipelaaja ja ystävällinen asiakaspalvelija.

Edellytämme sinulta:

- Kokemusta matkailualan opastyöstä, mieluiten Lapista

- Oma-aloitteisuutta, joustavuutta ja paineensietokykyä

- Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa

- B-ajokorttia sekä kokemusta moottorikelkan käsittelystä


Tarjoamme sinulle

- Kokoaikaisen työn talvikaudeksi 2026-2027

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan 14-17 €/tunti kokemuksen ja osaamisen huomioiden (MARATES)

- Hyvän perehdytyksen ja osaavien kollegoiden tuen läpi kauden

- Työsuhdeasumisen (vuokra alkaen 400 €/kk)

- Työpaikkaruokailut: 8 €/lounas ja 4,50 €/aamupala

- Pienen työyhteisön rennon ja yhteisöllisen ilmapiirin

- Erinomaiset vapaa-ajanviettomahdollisuudet kauniissa tunturiluonnossa

- Vuokravälineitä edullisesti luontoharrastuksiin

- Ilmaisen pääsyn kunnan kuntosalille

- Mahdollisuuden vuokrata kauttamme tilapäisesti myös autoa

- Laadukkaan työterveyshuollon


Eduksi katsomme:

- Matkailualan moniosaamisen ja koulutuksen alalta

- Muun sujuvan kielitaidon (esim. saksa, ranska, hollanti)

- Ensiapu-kortin

- Hygieniapassin

- Pohjois-Lapin alueellisen tuntemuksen


Jos kiinnostuit ja koet, että kausityö Suomen huipulla olisi juuri sinua varten, lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi meille sähköpostitse. Etenemme työntekijöiden valinnassa jo hakuajan aikana sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 20.9.2026. Ilmoitamme valinnan etenemisestä ja päätöksistä henkilökohtaisesti.

  • Fleksibel og ta ansvar når det trengs
  • Bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Godt og stabilt arbeidsmiljø
  • Årsturnus med fagdager
  • Arbeid for tiden på natt med for tiden hver 3. helg
  • Interessante faglige utfordringer og mulighet for faglig og personlig utvikling

jobs.title: Senior Sales Account Manager, Marine
jobs.description:
Cadmatic is a leading global developer of digital and intelligent 3D-based design, engineering, and information management solutions for the marine, process, and construction industries. Our journey started in the 1980s. Over the past decade, we have grown by 20 percent annually, and it's all about talent. We truly value our people – many stay with us for years, with an average tenure of 10 years. Today we have over 330 proactive, engaged, and growth-minded people in 20 countries around the world. Over 6000 customers are using our software solutions in 60 countries. In the marine industry, our technology supports around 45 percent of the worlds shipyards. We continue strong growth.

We are looking for a Senior Sales Account Manager, Marine to strengthen and grow our Marine business across the Nordic & Baltic region. In this role, you will combine strategic account management, new business development, and regional growth. You will take ownership of selected key customer relationships, develop new opportunities across the marine ecosystem, drive complex sales opportunities end-to-end, and help customers improve engineering productivity, collaboration, and information management.

The position is preferably based in Finland, with flexibility for the right candidate elsewhere in the Nordics. You will work as part of an international sales organization as a senior individual contributor.

In short, your job includes:

- Growing Cadmatics Marine business across the Nordic & Baltic region through strategic account management, new customer acquisition, and regional business development
- Owning and developing selected strategic customer relationships, creating long-term account plans, and identifying growth opportunities across the Marine portfolio, including Cadmatic Hull, Cadmatic Outfitting, Cadmatic Electrical, Cadmatic P&ID, eShare, and Wave (PLM)
- Identifying, pursuing, and closing new business opportunities with shipyards, ship design and engineering companies, shipowners, and other marine industry stakeholders
- Leading complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery and stakeholder mapping through commercial negotiations and closing
- Building trusted relationships with senior technical, operational, procurement, and executive stakeholders
- Collaborating closely with solution consulting, product, customer success, delivery, and marketing teams to create customer value, maintain a healthy pipeline, and represent Cadmatic at industry events and customer meetings

We wish you to bring:

- A degree in Engineering, Naval Architecture, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained within marine, shipbuilding, engineering software, or industrial technology
- 8+ years of experience in complex B2B sales, strategic account management, or business development ideally within engineering software, marine technology, PLM, CAD/CAE, digital twin, or related industrial software solutions
- Strong understanding of the marine and shipbuilding ecosystem and how technology purchasing decisions are made, with a proven track record of growing strategic accounts and winning new business in enterprise-level environments
- Experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales processes, commercial negotiations, and competitive evaluations, combined with confidence in discussing engineering workflows, information management, and digitalization topics with both technical and commercial decision-makers
- A structured, proactive, and self-driven approach to territory planning, forecasting, and opportunity management
- Excellent English skills. Finnish or another Nordic language is considered a strong advantage

Cadmatic as an employer:

- A stable, global company with a long history, strong future, and advanced software solutions
- A friendly, supportive, and truly multicultural work environment where we succeed together
- Autonomy, ownership, and trust: youre encouraged to do your best work and develop professionally
- Competitive benefits and flexible working practices that support work-life balance
- An engineer-minded, people-first culture where we take our work seriously and also enjoy ourselves along the way

Join our growth journey!

Delight us with your application by September 30, 2026. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our Talent Manager Irene Paju via email at irene.paju@cadmatic.com. Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

We will share the salary range in the interview invitation with candidates who progress to the interview stage.

We believe in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to building a company culture where we cherish diversity and promote equity, and where everyone feels valued and respected. We firmly believe that success comes from building an inclusive company culture and providing equal opportunities for our People.

jobs.title: Combat Management System Integrator, Saab Finland, Turku/Rauma
jobs.description:
Tehtävänkuvaus

Tässä roolissa tulet osallistumaan Saabin 9LV taistelujohtojärjestelmän käyttöönottoon Raumalla vuosina 2026-2029 osana Laivue 2020 -hanketta. Combat Management System Integraattorina vastaat siitä, että Saab 9LV -taistelunjohtojärjestelmä (CMS) toimii yhtenä kokonaisuutena muiden taistelujärjestelmän (CS) alijärjestelmien, kuten sensoreiden, tutkien, luotaimien ja asejärjestelmien kanssa. Työssäsi huolehdit Saab 9LV CMS järjestelmän testausvalmiuden saavuttamisesta laivoilla yhdessä Saabin tiimin kanssa. Teet lisäksi tarvittaessa vianrajaus- ja selvitystöitä sekä integrointi-, suorituskyky- ja hyväksymistestausta. Pääset myös käyttöönottamaan järjestelmien uusia ohjelmistoversioita.

Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä Saabin testaus-, ohjelmistokehitys- ja asiakasorganisaatioiden sekä myös muiden järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa. Et ole yksin tässä roolissa vaan sinulla on vertaistukena muut CMS integraattorit niin Suomessa kuin Ruotsissa.

Työtehtävään perehtyminen tapahtuu vuoden 2026 aikana Tampereella ja Turussa. Perehtymisen aikana pääasiallinen työssäkäyntipaikkasi tulee olemaan Tampere, jossa toivomme sinun pystyvän työskentelemään noin puolet työviikosta. Turkuun suuntautuvia työmatkoja tulee olemaan arviolta joka toinen tai kolmas viikko.

Käyttöottovaiheessa pääasiallinen työssäkäyntipaikkasi tulee olemaan Rauma, jossa pääset käyttämään oppimiasi taitoja yhdessä muun Saabin käyttöönottotiimin kanssa.

Tarjoamme
- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä Suomen merkittävimmissä merivoimien modernisointihankkeissa
- Pitkäksi aikaa mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä – projektit jatkuvat vuosia
- Kansainvälisen ja teknisesti huippuluokan ympäristön
- Työn, jossa yhdistyvät ohjelmistot, sulautetut järjestelmät, verkot ja käytännön integraatiotyö

Työtehtävät
- Testausvalmiuden saavuttaminen
- Vianselvitys ja viasta palautuminen, teknisten ongelmien korjaus
- Tietojen kerääminen vikojen ja löydösten raportointia varten
- Integrointi-, kuormitus/suorituskyky- ja hyväksymistestaus
- CS/CMS-järjestelmien käyttöönotto ja integraatiotyö laivoilla ja tukikohdissa
- Yhteistyö testinsuorittajien, kehitystiimien ja kansainvälisten kollegoiden kanssa

Etsimme

- Soveltuva koulutustausta (esim. järjestelmä-, ohjelmisto- tai automaatiotekniikka)
- Kokemusta Linux komentorivin ja Dockerin käytöstä sekä tietoverkoista ja verkkolaitteista
- Valmius työskennellä konkreettisissa ympäristöissä, joissa yhdistyy ohjelmisto, laitteisto ja verkot
- Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halu toimia asiakasrajapinnassa
- Matkustusvalmius erityisesti Raumalle ja Turkuun
- Sujuva suomi ja englanti

Arvostamme, jos sinulla on seuraavaa osaamista
- IP/Ethernet-verkot ja verkkoteknologiat
- Verkkoliikenteen analysointityökalut
- Hajautetut järjestelmät ja tietoväylät
- Tietokone- ja palvelinlaitteisto
- Git, Artifactory tai vastaava
- CI/CD-ympäristöt
- Kokemusta Jirasta tai vastaavasta tikettijärjestelmästä
- Ruotsin kielen osaaminen

Menestyäksesi roolissa olet:
- Oppimishaluinen, utelias ja aidosti kiinnostunut monimutkaisista teknisistä järjestelmistä
- Rauhallinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen myös epävarmuutta sisältävissä tilanteissa
- Oma-aloitteinen ja systemaattinen – nautit siitä, että asiat toimivat ja pysyvät hallinnassa
- Kommunikoit sujuvasti eri sidosryhmien kanssa ja viihdyt käytännönläheisessä projektityössä

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle teetetään turvallisuusselvitys sekä huumausainetestit.

Rekrytointiprosessimme
Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin.

jobs.title: Campus Bornholm søger faglærer til elektrikeruddannelsen
jobs.description:
Campus Bornholm har fuld fart på elektrikeruddannelsen, vil du være en del af lærerholdet?

Da vores ene betroede faglærer, er gået på efterløn, søger Campus Bornholm en motiveret og engageret faglærer til vores elektrikeruddannelse. Uddannelsen er i vækst og vi har for nylig startet hovedforløb på Campus Bornholm.

Vi søger en medarbejder med masser af faglig stolthed og lyst til at lære fra sig. Du kommer til at indgå i et team på 5, hvoraf 3 er elektrikere, en datamatiker og en grundfagsunderviser. Som elektrikerfaglærer bliver du en del af undervisningen på grundforløb 1 og 2, samt hovedforløb, der vil ligeledes være brobygningsaktiviteter og forskellige projekter, hvor du kommer til at deltage.

I undervisningen er du sammen med en masse unge og voksne, der er nysgerrige for at lære og komme ud og arbejde i branchen.

På Campus Bornholm er din indsats synlig. Den afspejler sig hver dag i dine elever og kollegaer.

De primære opgaver er:

·         Undervisning på elektriker grundforløb, samt brobygningsforløb for grundskoleelever.

·         Undervisning på elektriker hovedforløb, samt udvikling af undervisningsforløb.

·         Indgå i skolens øvrige projekter. Fx åbne værksteder og lærepladsopsøgende virksomhed.

 Dine kvalifikationer:

Du er uddannet elektriker og har beskæftiget dig med faget i mindst 5 år.

Vi lægger stor vægt på bred erfaring og efteruddannelse indenfor EL-faget.

Derudover vil det tælle til din fordel, hvis du besidder nogle af nedenstående kvalifikationer:

·         Overbygning på din elektrikeruddannelse, gerne som installatør, eller kurser, mv.

·         Formel pædagogisk undervisningskompetence og relevant efteruddannelse er en fordel

·         Anden undervisningserfaring f.eks. fra lærlingearbejde, ungdomsskole, forsvaret, sport, mv.

·         Kan anvende IT-redskaber i tilknytning til arbejdet.

·         Kan arbejde såvel selvstændigt, som i teams.

Først og fremmest er det afgørende, at du har vilje og lyst til at arbejde med mennesker – unge, voksne, flygtninge, fagligt stærke/svage, og er parat til at udvikle dig både personligt, pædagogisk og fagligt.

 Personlige kompetencer:

·         Du har et godt humør, er robust, stabil, energisk og udadvendt.

Vi tilbyder dig:

·         Du indgår i et team på 5 faglærere, og et samlet faglærerkollegie på 30

·         Et spændende job med mange unge

·         En meget varieret hverdag

·         Stor frihed under ansvar

 Tiltrædelse

Vi ønsker stillingen besat pr. 1. november 2026, eller hurtigst muligt.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Cirkulære af 31. januar 2025 om aftale om løn for lærere ansat på tjenestemandslignende vilkår ved institutioner for erhvervsrettede uddannelser med virkning fra 1. april 2024 (Medst.nr. 010-25)

En ny overenskomst træder i kraft med virkning fra 1. april 2027.

Der er knyttet prøvetid på 2 år, samt en attraktiv pensionsordning til stillingen.

Som faglærer, skal du inden prøvetidens udløb have påbegyndt en pædagogisk diplomuddannelse medmindre du har en PG eller tilsvarende.

Lønnen vil som udgangspunkt følge statens regler for lærere ansat på tjenestemandslignende vilkår ved institutioner for erhvervsrettede uddannelser.

Lønnen udgør 30.713,82 – 36.731,53 kr. pr. måned afhængigt af anciennitet. Hertil kommer 18 % fuldt arbejdsgiverbetalt pension.

Arbejdstid: 37 timer

Ansøgningsfrist: mandag d. 21. september

Samtaler: Afholdes i uge 39/40

Ansøgning via skolens hjemmeside: https://campusbornholm.dk/job

 Campus Bornholm ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder John Anker på telefon 30650282 eller mail ja@cabh.dk
