jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Control Systems Nuclear Reactors on Ships
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We invite applications for a PhD research position in nuclear reactor control.
The work will be embedded in the SFI - SAINT project Sustainable, Applied and Industrialized Nuclear Technology, which supports the launch of 2-3 nuclear powered demonstration ships in the early 2030s. Within the SAINT project, you will work in Work package 5.

Controlling a nuclear reactor on a ship presents a fundamentally different challenge from controlling a land-based plant. A shipboard reactor must respond to a continuously varying electrical and propulsion load, driven by weather, sea state, maneuvering demands, and onboard consumers, while maintaining safe and stable operation within tight physical and regulatory constraints. This requires integration between the reactor control system and the ship's power management system, coordinating responses across timescales that range from slow thermal transients to rapid load swings during berthing or heavy seas.

In this position, you will develop and implement modern control strategies for a shipboard nuclear reactor, with a primary focus on the interface between reactor output and the ship's overall power demand. This work will be carried out on a nuclear reactor simulator, with the possibility of validating results on a physical non-nuclear test system. You will design control algorithms that handle the full range of operational states, from steady cruising to rapid load changes and emergency scenarios, and ensure that the reactor and ship-side power systems behave as a coherent, stable whole rather than two independently optimised systems.

The position is part of a broader interdisciplinary effort within SAINT, and you will collaborate with researchers working across nuclear engineering, naval architecture, electrical power systems, and maritime operations. The findings are expected to have direct relevance for reactor vendors, shipbuilders, and the regulatory frameworks being developed for maritime nuclear propulsion

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Naval vessels and polar icebreakers have operated on nuclear power for decades. Nuclear propulsion is emerging as a serious candidate for the decarbonization of deep-sea and high-utilisation vessels in Norway and internationally, offering greater energy independence, higher sustained speeds, and extended range compared to conventional fuel-based propulsion. International bodies are actively establishing the frameworks that will govern the civil use of nuclear propulsion and the foundational engineering knowledge is being established right now.

SAINT (Sustainable, Applied and Industrialized Nuclear Technology) is a research project investigating the use of nuclear propulsion for commercial and specialist maritime vessels and aims at launching 2-3 demonstration ships in the early 2030s. SAINT addresses the technical, safety, and operational challenges that must be resolved before such systems can be responsibly deployed. PhD candidates will be among the people shaping this emergent field. In the intersection of nuclear and maritime engineering qualified engineers and researchers are scarce globally. Candidates who complete a PhD within the SAINT project will be well positioned for careers in nuclear safety, maritime regulation, advanced vessel design, and the emerging commercial nuclear sector.

The project is hosted at the Department of Ocean Operations and Civil Engineering (IHB) at NTNU in Ålesund, a campus with deep roots in maritime engineering and ship design. Around 70 PhD students are at NTNU in Ålesund, roughly 40 of which are in IHB working on ship design, naval control systems and in shipping management. Within the project we are aiming to recruit up to ten PhD students and one or two Post Docs to work in parallel across the core engineering challenges of maritime nuclear propulsion, creating an unusually dense and collaborative internal research environment in which you will collaborate with researchers working across nuclear engineering, naval architecture, electrical power systems, and maritime operations.

The project is carried out in close collaboration with thirty industry partners spanning shipbuilders, reactor vendors, turbine manufacturers, control system developers, classification societies, and maritime operators. A dedicated test center for non-nuclear testing of reactor and turbine systems is under construction, giving SAINT researchers hands-on access to hardware validation at a scale rarely available in academic maritime research.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Cooperate with our industrial partners

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in physics, control engineering, electrical engineering, nuclear engineering, mechanical engineering or a closely related field. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme Engineering
  • You must have high proficiency in both written and oral English
  • We can not accept applications of citizens from countries on the OFAC and EAR lists and countries under US arms embargoes as well as heavy restricted/ITAR proscribed countries.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including classical and modern control design methods
  • Experience with modelling and simulation of dynamic systems
  • Programming proficiency sufficient for implementing and testing control algorithms
  • Experience with nuclear reactor physics and thermal-hydraulics, or reactor simulation tools (e.g. RELAP, TRACE, or MOOSE)
  • Knowledge of electrical power systems and power management, particularly in isolated or islanded grids
  • Familiarity with marine or offshore power systems and their control architectures
  • Knowledge of real-time control systems, embedded systems, or industrial control platforms
  • Familiarity with nuclear regulatory frameworks and the safety requirements imposed on instrumentation and control systems

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

PLEASE NOTE: The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Please note that the person hired will work with critical infrastructure and areas affected by controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology.


Candidates who do not meet the requirements for the necessary security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the National Security Act, and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered (e.g., candidates from, among others, Russia, Iran, North Korea, China). Relevant countries are listed as examples and as such the list is not exhaustive (as a result of any changes in the world situation, other countries may be added at short notice).


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Philip Jacob Ferdinand Pfahl, e-mail: philip.j.f.pfahl@ntnu.no 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact PhD Coordinator Lara Bromann, e-mail: lara.bromann@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 4. October 2026.

Start of contract can be flexible, depending on the situation of the candidate.

jobs.title: R&D Engineer – Machining
jobs.description:
DAMRC is a research and development centre for advanced manufacturing. We are internationally recognised for our work in metal processing, and our job is to turn new technology into something Danish manufacturers can use on the shop floor.

You will work both in our own R&D centre in Herning, where trials can be run without stopping a production line, and out at the companies themselves, where the solution has to survive daily use.

We are now expanding the engineering team with two R&D Engineers.

Your role

As an R&D Engineer you will work on national and international research and development projects from the first idea through to implementation, at a high international technical level. Specifically, you will:

•     Drive the development and maturation of new machining technologies in our R&D centre

•     Play a central role in process and production optimisation for industrial customers

•     Work closely with cross-functional teams and industry partners

•     Contribute to technologies that support the green transition

•     Share what you find - with engineers, production managers and machine operators alike

Who we are looking for

We are filling two positions and they do not have to be identical profiles.

Essential

•     A degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering or equivalent

•     Real understanding of machining - the process itself, not just the theory around it

•     The ability to explain a technical result clearly to very different audiences, from design engineers to machine operators

•     Fluent English, written and spoken. Danish is not a requirement

Advantageous

•     Specialisation in materials engineering

•     Hands-on experience with material processing and machining techniques

•     Strong analytical skills and experience with trial design, measurement or data analysis

•     Strong IT skills and familiarity with current engineering tools and methods

Ambitious recent graduates are encouraged to apply. If you are early in your career we do not expect the experience - we expect curiosity and a willingness to get your hands dirty.

Eligibility. You must already be entitled to work in Denmark. We are not set up to handle work and residence permit applications, so we can only consider applicants who are citizens of the EU, EEA or Switzerland, or who already hold a valid Danish work permit.

What we offer

•     A high-technology research centre in strong growth, where you are invited to contribute both professionally and personally

•     Direct contact with our members and customers, and time spent inside companies most engineers never see from the inside

•     An innovative, supportive environment alongside highly skilled colleagues who share your interest in engineering

•     Work with technologies that drive the green agenda forward

Living in Herning

Interested in joining an international community in Denmark? Herning has a diverse expat network, and we will welcome you into it.

About DAMRC

DAMRC – Danish Advanced Manufacturing Research Center – is a leader in metal processing and is internationally recognised for ground-breaking innovation.

Our mission is to help Danish companies succeed through innovation and the use of the latest technology. We work in close collaboration with our members, which include several leading companies in metal processing and the machinery industry.

Since 2010 we have completed more than 400 industry projects.

We are a team of around 30 based at Industrivej Syd 17A, 7400 Herning, Denmark.

How to apply

We review applications as they arrive and will close the posting once we have found the right people, so there is no deadline — send yours when you are ready.

Send your application and CV to work@damrc.com with “R&D Engineer” in the subject line.

To hear more before applying, contact Rory Shaw (+45 2253 312/ros@damrc.com) or Sebastián Assain (+45 2222 5594/sea@damrc.com)

Your application and your personal data. We treat every application confidentially and process your personal data in accordance with the GDPR.

Vi søger på vegne af kunde i Herlev to erfarne Senior Konsulenter med stærke regnskabskompetencer og lyst til at tage et bredt ansvar.

Om rollen

Som Senior Konsulent får du ansvaret for egne kunder – primært mindre virksomheder – hvor du fungerer som deres "regnskabschef". Du vil have et dedikeret team af accountants, der varetager den daglige bogføring, mens du selv har ansvar for:

  • Finansbogholderi og afstemninger

  • Godkendelse af løn

  • Sparring med kunderne på økonomiske og forretningsmæssige spørgsmål

Du bliver en central del af opbygningen af et nyt team af seniorprofiler, og på sigt er der mulighed for at få ledelsesansvar, hvis du ønsker det.

Virksomheden er fuldt digitaliseret og arbejder med de nyeste teknologier, herunder AI-baserede løsninger, som understøtter en effektiv og moderne tilgang til regnskab og økonomistyring. Kulturen er præget af samarbejde, åbenhed og indflydelser på egen hverdag.

Vi tilbyder

  • En udfordrende og udviklende rolle, hvor du får ansvar for egne kunder

  • Mulighed for at forme og udvikle et nyt team

  • Gode rammer på kontoret i Herlev, herunder en lækker frokostordning og et stærkt socialt miljø

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har solid erfaring fra en rolle som controller, Senior Accountant eller Finance Accountant – gerne fra en lignende funktion, hvor du har haft ansvar for periodeluk, rapportering og controlling. Du er struktureret, kvalitetsbevidst og trives med at tage ansvar for hele regnskabsprocessen.

jobs.title: Fire Officer
jobs.description:
Position : Fire Officer

Business : Mall Operation

About the role:

Objective of the role:

You will oversee and ensure fire safety at your site. You will use the assigned apparatus and follow the command structure instructions for fire suppression or a related emergency service. Your duties will involve:

Responsibilities:

  • Performing equipment set-up upon arrival at a fire scene.
  • Dispatching and accompanying ERT (Emergency response team).
  • Preparing plans and executing (fire and life safety) evacuation drills and other fire safety related trainings to the team members and occupants available in the premises.
  • Completing appropriate rescue, firefighting and salvage operations at a fire scene.
  • Using established procedures to determine if individuals are trapped within a burning facility and taking appropriate actions to secure their rescue.
  • Performing the lift evacuation and rescue drill periodically.
  • Securing affected structure to prevent rekindling.
  • Taking inventory of all equipment after suppression has been achieved, recording all equipment, which must be left at the site and incident report.
  • Attending and providing information for pre-fire planning studies and maintaining an updated knowledge of pre-fire plans.
  • Liaison with Government authorities for periodic renewal of the NOCâs.
  • Report and maintain record of all the incidents of site.
  • Keep all the checklists and records updated related to Fire equipmentâs maintenance and training records.

Reporting:

You will be reporting to the Fire Safety Manager/ Operation Head as the case may be.

Sound like you? Here is what weâre looking for:

Being Analytical and Meticulous

You will ensure that all fire and life safety systems installed in the premises are working in an effective and efficient manner; and provide criteria on determining the number or type of fire equipmentâs needed in a given area.

Qualifications

You will have a Diploma/Degree in Fire Engineering OR Fire Safety with work experience of 3-5 years.

If you have a good knowledge of current fire suppression and firefighting techniques along with knowledge of the principles and practices involved in emergency medical services, you will be our preferred candidate.

What we can do for you:

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.

Contact & next steps

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

Vi søger en erfaren rengøringsleder til vores team.

jobs.title: RAVINTOLATYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ täysin uuteen Kivistön Ravintolamaailmaan, Seinäjoelle
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Hae RAVINTOLATYÖNTEKIJÄKSI täysin uuteen Kivistön Ravintolamaailmaan, Seinäjoelle!
Seinäjoen Kivistön liikekeskus uudistuu vuoden 2026 aikana ja avaamme kiinteistöön myös täysin uuden Ravintolamaailman. S-marketin yhteyteen rakentuva uusi ravintolatila tarjoaa viihtyisän kohtaamispaikan niin lounastajille, ostosten lomassa taukoa pitäville kuin perheillekin. Asiakkaita palvelevat jatkossa Hesburger Drive In ja Rosso Pizza -ravintola.

Tähän uuteen ravintolakokonaisuuteen haemme nyt ravintolatyöntekijöitä. Avoinna olevat työsuhteet ovat vakituisia ja määräaikaisia, osa-aikaisin työtunnein 12-75h/3vkoa. Monipuolinen osaaminen mahdollistaa hyvät sopimustunnit sekä mukavaa vaihtelua työhön, osa tehtävistä on yhdistettävissä myös opintojen oheen. Seinäjoen ravintolamaailmat Kivistö ja Prisma tekevät arjessa tiivistä yhteistyötä, joten tässä työssä ravintolatyöntekijän työn monipuolisuus toteutuu mahdollisuutena työskennellä kahdessa ravintola yksikössä. Työ onvauhdikasta ravintola-alan työtä, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitosi monipuolisestiasiakaspalvelun, myynnin, Hesburgerin sekä keittiön työtehtävissä.

Odotamme sinultaHaemme innostuneita ja motivoituneita tekijöitä ravintola-alan asiakaspalvelu- ja keittiötehtäviin. Arvostamme halua työskennellä monipuolisesti ravintolamaailman työpisteissä, olemme yhtä tiimiä, jossa pääset oppimaan sekä Hesburgerin että Rosso Pizzan työtehtäviä. Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelu tai myyntityöstä, kokin työstä, pizzan tai hampurilaisten valmistuksesta on ehdottomasti plussaa. Mikäli osaamiset ja kokemukset alalta ovat vielä vähäisiä, se ei ole este hakea, sillä joukossamme opit varsinaiseksi moniosaajaksi. Tärkeintä on positiivinen asenne ja halu oppia sekä intohimo ja kiinnostus alaa kohtaan. Teemme työtä tiiminä, joten arvostamme hyvää työkaveruutta ja yhteistyötaitoja. Edellytämme asiakaspalvelutilanteissa kommunikointikykyä suomenkielellä, joustavuutta työskennellä vuorotyössä ravintolan aukioloaikoina. Olethan myös täysi-ikäinen, 18-vuotta täyttänyt.

Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissatöissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia.

Tarjoamme sinulleErityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.
Koko henkilöstöämme koskevatulospalkkiojärjestelmä
Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan, kulttuurin ja hyvinvoinninEpassi-edut
Poikkeuksellisen paljon erilaisia mahdollisuuksia urallesi ja työkokemuksen kartuttamiseksi
Mahdollisuus ottaa vastaan lisätyötä oman osaamisesi ja toiveidesi mukaan

Työt alkavat loka-marraskuussa 2026, ja saat tehtävääsi kattavan sekä käytännönläheisen perehdytyksen. Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja haastattelemme jo hakuaikana.

Lisätietoja Julialta, ravintolapäällikkö
Julia Durham, puh. 010 764 7161
sp. Julia.durham@sok.fi

Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit. Tutustu meihin paremmin ja kurkkaa, mitä tulevat työkaverisi kertovat työstään – ehkä seuraava tarina on sinun.

jobs.title: Photography and adventure guide, Levi - Part Time
jobs.description:
Beyond Arctic is a leading photography-oriented tour operator based in Levi, Finland, specializing in outdoor and adventure travel. We offer unique and authentic experiences to guests seeking exclusivity and memorable adventures. With an emphasis on small groups, flexibility, and exceptional service, we focus on delivering the highest standard of Arctic experiences in the heart of Lapland. We are currently seeking passionate and experienced adventure guides to join our team for the 2026-2027 winter season. Both full-time and part-time positions are available.

About Beyond Arctic:

As a family-owned company, Beyond Arctic is committed to providing a positive and engaging work environment for our team. Our company culture revolves around a deep love for nature, photography, and delivering extraordinary experiences for our guests. We pride ourselves on offering small, intimate group tours, where personal connections and high-quality service are our top priority.

Your Role:

As a Beyond Arctic Adventure Guide, you will lead small groups up to 8 people through the stunning landscapes of Lapland. Your primary role will be to provide exceptional Arctic experiences, help guests capture the beauty of the Arctic, and share the wonders of Finnish culture and nature. Tours include Northern Lights photography, Arctic Animals and winter activities like snowshoeing, back-country skiing, ice fishing, and nature hikes.

Beyond Arctic is dedicated to sustainable travel, and we are a Green Activities certified service provider, involved in the Sustainable Travel Finland program to help preserve the Arctics natural beauty.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead small groups of guests on nature-based Arctic adventures in Lapland and taking photos during the activity.

- Give assistance and guidance in photography techniques and the use of cameras and equipment for our guests with their own photography gear.

- Share stories and insights about the local culture, wildlife, and natural wonders of the Arctic region.

- Offer exceptional customer service, ensuring a memorable and authentic experience for each guest.

- Ensure the safety and well-being of guests during all activities.

- Foster a warm and welcoming atmosphere, making guests feel valued and cared for.


Qualifications and Skills:

- B-driving license (mandatory).

- Fluency in English (required). Additional language skills, especially in Spanish, French, Italian, German or Portuguese, are highly valued

- Experience in outdoor guiding and leading groups.

- Customer service skills and a passion for sharing knowledge and telling stories.

- Photography experience is a plus, but we will provide photography training if needed. Interest and drive for self-development in night photography, portraiture and nature photography is preferred.

- Experience with photo editing software and DSLR-cameras or DSLM-cameras is a plus.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- First aid certification (Emergency First Response or similar) is preferred. A first aid course is provided before starting if needed.


What We Offer:

- A unique and adventurous working environment in a growing company.

- A fair and competitive salary with extra compensation for work performed in evenings, nights, Sundays, and holidays.

- Opportunities for personal and professional development in both photography and hospitality. Training and ongoing support throughout your employment at Beyond Arctic.

- A chance to work in one of the most pristine natural environments in the world.


Locations:

We are hiring for both Rovaniemi and Levi.

Apply now:

If you have a passion for nature, photography, and sharing your knowledge, we would love to hear from you! To apply, send your application with the subject line Photography Guide Winter 2026-2027 to careers@beyondarctic.com. If you have a photography portfolio, feel free to include it in your application. Work begins in October/November/December 2026.

jobs.description:
Vi er en flok dygtige SOSU-assistenter, som mangler en kollega pr. 01.10.26, eller snarest derefter. Stillingen er en fast dagvagtsstilling på 37 timer, men vi er fleksible og vil så vidt muligt imødekomme dine ønsker til timetal. Vi arbejder hver 2. weekend.

Vi har mange spændende sygeplejefaglige opgaver, og vi arbejder både med faglig og personlig udvikling. Som SOSU-assistent arbejder vi tæt sammen med de to teams i sektionen og vores sygeplejersker. 

I sektion Ørkild har vi den indstilling, at vi arbejder professionelt i et fællesskab, hvor vi sammen skal løse en faglig opgave med højst mulig kvalitet.

Vi er bevidste om at vi er ansat til to ting: faglighed og samarbejde. Vi arbejder i faste teams og er i gang fuld gang med arbejdet omkring den nye ældrelov, hvor der er hovedfokus på faglighed/borgerperspektivet og samarbejde. Vi holder dagligt møder vedr. tidlig opsporing, og hver uge holder vi teamsmøde, hvor vi arbejder med personcentret omsorg omkring borgere og os selv. Vi er en hjemmeplejegruppe i stor udvikling, hvor der er plads til gode grin og forskellighed. 

Hos os får du:

  • et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor vores hovedfokus er borgeren
  • et selvstændigt arbejde med ansvar og faglige udfordringer
  • en sektion, hvor vi arbejder med både faglig og personlig udvikling
  • stort fokus på tværfagligt samarbejde
  • tæt samarbejde med kompetente og erfarne kollegaer
  • mange forskellige sygeplejefaglige opgaver
  • gode kolleger, som har fokus på arbejdsmiljøet
  • frihed under ansvar
     

Vi mangler en medarbejder der:

  • er stabil, loyal og er engageret i sit arbejde

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.
For stillinger i Social, Sundhed og beskæftigelse skal der afleveres en privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i stillingen.
 

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 36.205 og 46.820 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

 

Ældreområdet 

Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.
Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældreliv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Men vi gør os altid umage med at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed. 
Vi insisterer på at skabe de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt. Vi har også høje forventninger til dig og til din faglighed. Du får lov at bruge det, du kan, og arbejde med det, du brænder mest for. 
Du vil få en synlig leder, du kan sparre med, og dejlige kolleger at dele hverdagen med. 

 

Om Svendborg Kommune

Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling. 

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden. 

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

jobs.title: House cleaner
jobs.description:
**Would you like a job where you can see the results of your work immediately and hear positive feedback from customers almost every day?**

We are looking for reliable, hardworking and positive-minded **House Cleaners** to join our team on a permanent basis.

Youll become part of a close-knit and supportive work community where high-quality work, reliability and a positive attitude are genuinely valued — and rewarded. Every day, youll visit different homes and meet people from all walks of life, so no two working days are exactly the same. If you enjoy working independently while knowing that you always have a supportive team behind you, this could be the right job for you.

For us, what matters most is not how many years of experience you have in the cleaning industry, but that you take pride in your work, treat customers with kindness and are willing to learn and develop. We provide you with the training, support and tools you need to succeed.

**What we offer**

- **A close-knit and supportive team:** Youll never have to face challenges alone. Help and support are always available when needed, and good work is genuinely recognized and appreciated.

- **Varied and flexible work:** Different homes and customers bring variety to your working days, so the job is never monotonous.

- **Fixed hourly pay:** Salary in accordance with the collective agreement (TES), based on experience, starting from **€12.26/hour**.

- **Performance-based incentives:** Good and consistent performance is rewarded — your hard work can also be reflected in your paycheck.

- **Clear and predictable working hours:** Assignments are generally scheduled on weekdays between **8:00 AM and 5:00 PM**, making it easier to balance work and free time.

- **Opportunities for growth:** Develop your skills as a professional cleaner and progress in your career as you gain experience.

- **Thorough onboarding and support:** Youll receive proper training for the job and equipment, so you wont be thrown straight into the deep end.


**What we expect from you**

Previous experience in professional cleaning is **not required**. The most important things are the right attitude and a willingness to learn. We particularly value the following:

- **Customer-oriented approach:** You treat customers with kindness and take their wishes and needs into consideration.

- **Attention to detail:** You take pride in your work and pay close attention to detail in every home.

- **Problem-solving skills:** You are able to work independently and find solutions even in unexpected situations.

- **Fluent Finnish:** You can communicate smoothly and confidently with both customers and team members.

- **Driving licence:** Having your own car is considered an advantage, as our cleaning assignments are located across the area we operate in.

- **Initiative and flexibility:** You adapt to varying working days and take responsibility for your own work.

- **Reliability and a positive attitude:** You stick to agreed schedules and bring good energy to the team.


**What does a typical workday look like?**

Your working day will consist of several home cleaning assignments, which vary from day to day. Youll receive a clear route and task list, so youll always know what is expected at each location.

Some customers will become familiar faces from week to week, making the work personal and rewarding. Youll see firsthand how your work makes your customers everyday lives easier — and youll be able to see the results of your work immediately.

jobs.title: Kirjastotoimenjohtajan virka
jobs.description:
Heinäveden kunnan kirjastotoimenjohtajan virka vapautuu organisaatiomuutoksen myötä ja virka täytetään toistaiseksi voimassa olevana 1.1.2027 alkaen.

Kirjastotoimenjohtaja johtaa vapaa-aikapalveluiden osastoa sekä vastaa kunnan kirjastopalveluista. Tehtävään kuuluu vapaa-aikapalveluiden kokonaisuuden strateginen kehittäminen sekä kirjastopalveluiden toiminnan, talouden ja henkilöstön johtaminen.

Vapaa-aikapalveluiden osaston vastuulle kuuluvat kirjastopalvelut, kulttuuri- ja opistopalvelut, liikunta- ja nuorisopalvelut, hyvinvoinnin ja terveyden edistämisen työ sekä kotouttamispalvelut. Kutakin tulosyksikköä johtaa oma esihenkilö. Kirjastotoimenjohtajan suoria alaisia ovat vapaa-aikaohjaaja, koordinaattori (viestintä ja kulttuuri), koordinaattori (kotouttaminen) sekä kirjaston tietopalvelusihteerit.

Virkaan kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto. Lisäksi edellytetään hyvää perehtyneisyyttä vapaa-aikapalveluiden, kirjastojen tehtäviin ja toimintaan sekä johtamistaitoa lain yleisistä kirjastoista (1492/2016) 17 §:n mukaisesti.

Arvostamme kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä, kykyä toiminnan, palveluiden ja talouden kehittämiseen, henkilöstöjohtamisen osaamista, erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä verkostoitumis- ja sidosryhmäyhteistyöosaamista.

Virassa noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa ja valituksi tulleen on ennen vaalin vahvistamista ja viran vastaanottamista toimitettava hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan. Työehtosopimuksena virassa noudatetaan kunta-alan virka — ja työehtosopimusta (KVTES). Palkkaus 3 600 euroa.

Työsuhde-etuna tarjoamme uuden ja monipuolisen kuntosalin käytön, ePassi-edun sekä ehtojen täyttyessä kolme kuukautta veloituksetonta asumista (lisätiedot kunnan verkkosivuilta https://www.heinavesi.fi/asuminen-ja-tontit/).

Rekrytoinnin aikataulun mukaisesti haku on avoinna 31.8.–27.9.2026, haastattelut suoritetaan viikoilla 40–41 ja varsinainen valintapäätös tehdään 19.10.2026 kunnanhallituksen kokouksessa.

Hakemukset toimitetaan sähköisesti kunta@heinavesi.fi / viite kirjastoimenjohtaja tai postitse Heinäveden kunta, Kermanrannantie 7, 79700 Heinävesi su 27.9.2026 mennessä.

Lisätietoja: kunnanjohtaja Maarika Kasonen puh. 0405505811 maarika.kasonen@heinavesi.fi

jobs.title: diætist eller ernæringsfaglig profil med stærk træningsfaglighed
jobs.description:
Hos KNAAP arbejder vi med mennesker – ikke bare kostplaner.

Vi hjælper vores klienter med at skabe varige resultater gennem vaner, struktur, træning og forståelse.

Nu søger vi en dygtig og engageret diætist eller ernæringsfaglig profil med stærk træningsfaglighed, som ønsker at arbejde helhedsorienteret med både kost, træning og coaching.

Om stillingen

Som en del af KNAAP får du ansvar for dine egne klienter og følger dem tæt gennem deres forløb.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Kostvejledning og livsstilsforløb

  • Personlig træning

  • Coaching og adfærdsændringer

  • Opbygning af sunde vaner og struktur i hverdagen

Hos os handler et forløb ikke om kost eller træning isoleret. Du skal kunne møde det hele menneske og skabe sammenhæng mellem klientens mål, hverdag, vaner, kost og træning.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er uddannet klinisk diætist, professionsbachelor i ernæring og sundhed eller har en tilsvarende relevant faglig baggrund

  • Har solid erfaring med træning og føler dig tryg i rollen som personlig træner

  • Har stærk træningsfaglig viden og kan omsætte den til praksis

  • Kan skabe et trygt og tillidsfuldt rum for klienterne

  • Har gode coachingevner og forståelse for adfærdsændringer

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og tager ansvar for dine klientforløb

  • Brænder for at gøre en reel og varig forskel i menneskers liv

Vi tilbyder:

  • En fleksibel deltidsstilling på ca. 10–32 timer om ugen

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge dine egne forløb

  • Et fagligt stærkt og moderne setup

  • Et meningsfuldt arbejde med fokus på varige resultater

  • Faglig sparring og mulighed for udvikling

Arbejdet foregår primært i vores center i Valby, og arbejdstiden kan ligge både morgen, eftermiddag og aften. Weekendarbejde kan aftales, hvis det hænger bedre sammen for dig.

Om KNAAP

KNAAP er skabt med en ambition om at gøre op med quick fixes og standardløsninger.

Vi arbejder evidensbaseret med mennesker, vaner, kost og træning, med fokus på at skabe resultater, der fungerer i virkeligheden og holder på lang sigt.

Opstart hurtigst muligt.

Er du interesseret, eller kender du den rette person, så send en mail til kontakt@knaap.dk.

jobs.title: Vikarie till olika köksuppgifter i Kristinestad
jobs.description:
Vi söker inhoppare till Kristinestad för olika köksuppgifter. Oavsett om du har bakgrund som storkock eller diskare söker vi pigga och motiverade personer för vikariat av olika längd.
I Kristinestads område samt i närliggande kommuner finns skolor och daghem vars kök periodvis är i behov av vikarier. Har du behov av inhopp eller vill du få in en fot genom dörren? Här har du en utmärkt möjlighet att bekanta dig med arbetsuppgifter vid olika enheter.

Vi söker yrkeskunniga och utbildade kockar samt köksbiträden för assisterande uppgifter.
- För kockuppgifter kräver vi utbildning eller minst arbetserfarenhet från motsvarande uppgifter samt språkkunskaper (finska eller svenska).
- Som köksbiträde söker vi pigga och motiverade personer, som har erfarenhet av olika arbetsuppgifter i köksmiljö. Språkkunskaper i första hand finska eller svenska, men även god engelska räcker.

Vad vi söker:
- Behovet gäller i synnerhet inhoppare, så vi uppskattar möjlighet att ta emot arbetspass även med kort varsel. Samma vikarier tillfrågas i första hand också för längre vikariat.
- Arbetspassen är alltid vardagar mellan kl. 7–17.
- Tillgång till egen bil, eftersom vikariat även kan förekomma i närområdet.
- Giltigt hygienpass krävs.
Vi erbjuder en bra introduktion!

Vi följer KVTES lönetabell:
- Kock (grundlön 4RUO50B1): timlön 15,25 €
- Kock (grundlön 4RUO50A1): timlön 13,95 €
- Köksbiträde (grundlön 4RUO70A1): timlön 13,32 €

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice de structure d'hébergement touristique (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

jobs.title: People Partner - Engineering, Product, Design (EPD)
jobs.description:
TL;DR: We're hiring a Human Resources Business Partner to partner with Engineering, Product & Design (EPD) at Lovable - our largest and fastest-growing organization. You'll act as a trusted advisor to the leadership team, and fly at many different altitudes every day. You’ll advise on org design, location strategy, talent planning, employee relations, manager effectiveness, and change management as we scale across Stockholm and London.

This is an in-office role is based in Stockholm or London.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

The Role

You'll be deeply embedded with Engineering, Product, and Design as a strategic partner and operator: someone leaders trust for candid coaching, clear judgment, and pragmatic execution. You will spot patterns before they become problems, bring structure without slowing the team down, and turn People programs into AI enabled operating rhythms that work for a technical org.

What You'll Do

  • Strategic People Partnership — build deep partnerships with EPD leaders and act as a trusted advisor on the people decisions that shape the business: team design, leadership effectiveness, talent density, retention, and change.

  • AI-Native People Operations — rethink how work gets done in an AI-native company: experiment with AI-enabled workflows to increase velocity and craftsmanship (e.g., manager enablement, insight generation, communications, and operating rhythms), and help EPD leaders adopt them in a thoughtful, human-first way.

  • Org Design & Headcount Planning — partner with Eng Leads, Finance, Recruiting, and People Ops to bring clarity and discipline to workforce planning, reporting lines, role definition, spans/layers, contractor strategy, and future org shape.

  • Performance Reviews — Run EPD's quarterly Signal Review cycle end-to-end, including manager prep, calibration, monitor/at-risk categorization, level corrections, follow-through, and clean operating rhythms.

  • Talent Insights & Retention — use qualitative signal and people data to identify hot spots, flight risks, manager gaps, and team-level patterns early; translate those insights into practical interventions.

  • Employee Relations & Risk Management — own complex employee situations, performance improvement plans, investigations, resignations, probation issues, and terminations for EPD in partnership with Legal and People Ops.

  • Manager & Leadership Coaching — coach technical leaders through hard conversations, promotion readiness, org changes, feedback, accountability, team health, and moments where clarity matters more than consensus.

  • People Program Execution — help shape and roll out scalable People programs for EPD, including manager enablement, career pathing, leveling consistency, compensation cycles, engagement follow-up, and change management.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years as an HRBP or People Partner, with meaningful experience directly supporting Engineering, Product, Design, Research, or similarly technical organizations.

  • Experience at an AI-native, developer tools, product-led, or high-growth technology company.

  • Strong business judgment and the ability to connect people decisions to company priorities, product velocity, leadership effectiveness, and team performance.

  • Excellent judgment in employee relations, including sensitive performance, conduct, probation, resignation, and termination situations.

  • Comfortable giving hard feedback to senior technical leaders while maintaining strong relationships and discretion.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, pace, and imperfect systems in a company where structure is still being built in real time.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Manager - Maritime (All Genders)
jobs.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

STARK's maritime division is at the forefront of autonomous surface and subsea innovation. We are building the next generation of modular, sensor-integrated maritime platforms designed to dominate in complex, contested environments. You will work closely with cross-functional teams of systems engineers, naval architects, and software developers to bridge the gap between cutting-edge engineering and operational deployment. Our team values rapid iteration, technical rigour, and a bias for action in everything we build.


Your mission

As Product Manager for Maritime, you own the development of STARK’s software-defined maritime capabilities and complex sensor suites. You will direct the integration of these systems by driving high-tempo collaboration with System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams. Your mission is to translate tactical operational requirements into dominant, mass-scalable platforms that ensure NATO maritime superiority.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end development of software-defined maritime capabilities and mission-critical sensor suites.

  • Direct the integration of advanced sensors and autonomous software by leading collaboration across System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams.

  • Drive product testing strategies—including Software-in-the-Loop (SITL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL), and full hardware/software integrations—in lockstep with System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams.

  • Lead strategic market analysis to identify and capture platform opportunities for NATO allied forces.

  • Manage the complete product lifecycle from prototype to deployment and customer acceptance.

  • Enforce rigorous safety and compliance standards across the maritime product portfolio.

  • Communicate product vision and strategic milestones to internal stakeholders and external defence partners.


Qualifications

  • Technical degree (e.g. Maritime/Systems Engineering, CS) or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in product management delivering complex maritime/defence systems.

  • Understanding of maritime operations and sensor integration.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and navigate regulatory requirements.

  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a UK security clearance.


Nice to have

  • Experience with naval projects or autonomous/robotic platforms.

  • Background in defence-tech or rapid-growth aerospace.

  • Experience working in a V-model while maintaining agile development pace.


If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected in the description above, please send us your CV in English. We look forward to meeting you!

Ravintola on ympäristönä tyypillisesti nopeatempoinen, joten hyvä paineensietokyky ja organisointitaidot varmistavat työssä onnistumisen. Etsimäämme henkilöä kuvaavat adjektiivit ammattitaitoinen ja rempseä. Toivomme hyvää työmotivaatiota, mutta myös hyvää huumorintajua, sillä töissä pitää olla myös hauskaa!

Asiakkuuteen liittyvät tarkemmat tiedot tarkentuvat rekrytoinnin aikana.

* Aiempaa kokemusta keittiötyöstä ja/tai alan koulutusta
* Oma-aloitteisuutta sekä joustavuutta
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa (Fluent Finnish language skills)

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

* Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn
* Mukavat työkaverit ja rennon työympäristön työskentelyyn
* Totalin henkilöstön avun ja tuen työsuhteesi kaikissa vaiheissa

Miten prosessi etenee?

Jos tunnistit itsesi kuvauksesta, kerro osaamisestasi lisää jättämällä hakemuksesi ja cv. Olemme sinuun yhteydessä haastatteluiden merkeissä.

Jos mieleesi heräsi kysymyksiä, niin ole rohkeasti yhteydessä Mikaan, arkisin klo 8-16, 040 158 7067, mika@totalhenkilostopalvelut.fi



* Jätä työnhaku meidän huoleksemme*

Total-Henkilöstöpalvelut on henkilöstötalo, joka pyrkii edistämään ja lisäämään pidempikestoisia työsuhteita. Olemme keskittyneet laadukkaaseen ja pitkäjänteiseen yhteistyöhön asiakasyritystemme kanssa, mikä mahdollistaa pidempiaikaisten työsuhteiden tarjonnan ja usein vakinaistumisen mahdollisuuden työnhakijoillemme. jobs.title: Doctoral researcher in Radiopharmaceutical Chemistry
jobs.description:
The University of Helsinki, founded in 1640, is one of the worlds leading universities for multidisciplinary research. The university has an international academic community of 40,000 students and staff members. The Department of Chemistry (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science/faculty/chemistry) at the Faculty of Science carries out research on chemistry and its applications at an international level and provides academic teaching based on high-quality research.
Radiopharmaceutical Chemistry research at the departments Tracers in Molecular Imaging (TRIM) research group led by Associate Prof. Mirkka Sarparanta is focused on the development of new molecular imaging tracers for positron emission tomography (PET) and single-photon emission computed tomography (SPECT) and therapeutic radioligands for different biomedical applications including oncology, drug delivery and neuroimaging. In addition, we offer training at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels in Radiopharmaceutical Chemistry at the University of Helsinki.
The Department of Chemistry invites applications for a fixed-term
DOCTORAL RESEARCHER
position in Radiopharmaceutical Chemistry under the supervision of Associate Professor, Dr. Mirkka Sarparanta. The successful applicant will join the TRIM research group at the Department of Chemistry and enroll in one of the doctoral programs at the University of Helsinki. The work is scheduled to start in January 2026 or as soon as a suitable candidate has been found. This is a fixed-term position of approximately 3,5 years.
Position description
The Research Council of Finland funded PhD project aims to develop new alpha-emitting radioligands for the treatment of multiorgan metastasis of cancer. Your work will involve organic synthesis, purification and characterization of radiolabeling precursors, radiolabeling synthesis development, radiolabeled compound characterization and biological evaluation of the developed ligands in vitro in cell models and in vivo in mouse tumor models with PET and SPECT imaging and biodistribution studies. You are expected to present your findings to collaborators and in scientific meetings, prepare funding applications for travel grants, as well as lead the writing of manuscripts for publication in international scientific journals. You will have shared responsibilities in management of the facilities of the research group. You are also expected to teach on the laboratory courses in Radiochemistry and supervise undergraduate student laboratory work accounting to approximately 5% of the working time annually.
Requirements
Motivated candidates with a M.Sc. degree or equivalent in Chemistry, Radiochemistry, Pharmacy, Biochemistry or other related fields are encouraged to apply. Prior experience in laboratory work, in organic synthesis and compound characterization is highly desirable. Experience in other relevant experimental methods, and in handling of radioactive materials and research animals are advantageous, but most importantly you should have a strong motivation for research in a highly multidisciplinary topic, enthusiasm to learn these methods and contribute ideas, and possess the ability to conduct your research independently while being an active member of an international research team. Good written and oral communication skills in English will be needed. Willingness and ability to travel within the EU for research visits is necessary as parts of the project will be conducted at collaborating laboratories in Sweden and Poland. Work necessitates handling of radioactivity. The selected candidate must meet the eligibility requirements for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/admissions-and-education/apply-doctoral-programmes) and prepare and apply for a doctoral study right within the trial period of 6 months.
Salary and benefits
The salary will be in accordance with the University salary system (for teaching and research personnel, starting level 2). In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal performance. The starting salary will be approximately 2600–2800 €/month.
The University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
How to apply
Applications should include a CV (with possible list of publications included), a copy of your transcript records (the courses completed during your M.Sc. program), and a letter (maximum 1 page) with a description of your research interests and why you would be a suitable candidate for the project. Please send us an application that you have crafted yourself, reflecting your own capability and thoughts. Applications generated by AI do not meet our expectations.
External applicants, please submit your application via theApply Nowbutton.
The deadline for applications is September 30, 2026. Top candidates will be interviewed in October 2026.
Additional information
For further inquiries regarding the position, please contact Dr. Mirkka Sarparanta (mirkka.sarparanta@helsinki.fi).

jobs.title: Klar til næste skridt – og har du lyst til at sætte retning for børns sproglige udvikling?
jobs.description:
I Børnehuset Grundtvigsvej søger vi en uddannet pædagog på 37 timer, som brænder for 0-6-årsområdet – og som har interesse for sprog, kommunikation og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.

Måske er du allerede sprogvejleder – eller måske drømmer du om at udvikle dig i den retning gennem videreuddannelse og faglig fordybelse.

Uanset hvad søger vi en kollega, der er nysgerrig på, hvordan sprog, leg og relationer hænger sammen med børns trivsel og udvikling.

Om os

Børnehuset Grundtvigsvej rummer 40 børnehavebørn og 24 vuggestuebørn, og vi er et engageret team på 14 medarbejdere, heraf 8 med pædagogfaglig baggrund.

Vi ser os selv som ét fælles hus, hvor alle voksne tager ansvar for alle børn. Derfor arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af vuggestue og børnehave, og vi søger en pædagog, der er fleksibel og trives med at være en aktiv del af hele huset.

Hos os er faglig refleksion en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi ved, at børnegrupper og behov forandrer sig, og derfor arbejder vi kontinuerligt med at justere vores praksis og læringsmiljøer, så de understøtter børnenes trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse bedst muligt.

Lige nu er vi særligt optagede af:

  • Legens betydning for udvikling og fællesskaber
  • Deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn
  • Udvikling af inspirerende læringsmiljøer
  • Sprog og kommunikation i hverdagens rutiner, relationer og lege

Vi er samtidig i gang med en spændende udviklingsproces omkring organisering og pædagogisk retning. Derfor søger vi en kollega, som har lyst til at bidrage med idéer, refleksioner og faglige perspektiver.

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for at arbejde målrettet med børns sproglige udvikling og deltagelse
  • Mulighed for videreuddannelse eller kompetenceudvikling inden for sprogvejledning
  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og plads til nye idéer
  • En mentorordning med fokus på tryg opstart og faglig sparring
  • Reel indflydelse på udviklingen af læringsmiljøer og pædagogisk praksis
  • Et stærkt kollegafællesskab med forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer
  • En engageret og opbakkende forældregruppe

Dine kommende kolleger fortæller

Vi er en mangfoldig personalegruppe med forskellige erfaringer, aldre og faglige styrker – fælles for os er passionen for det gode børneliv.

  • Vi elsker vores legeplads og bruger naturen aktivt året rundt.
  • Hver uge laver vi mad over bål sammen med børnene.
  • Fællesfredag er et vigtigt samlingspunkt, hvor store og små mødes på tværs.

Vi drømmer om en pædagog, der

  • Er engageret, nærværende og elsker at være tæt på børnene
  • Har interesse for sprogudvikling, kommunikation og inkluderende læringsmiljøer
  • Måske allerede er sprogvejleder – eller har lyst til at udvikle sig i den retning
  • Kan skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn gennem leg, relationer og hverdagens rutiner
  • Er reflekterende omkring egen praksis og bidrager aktivt til faglige drøftelser
  • Kan tage ansvar og samtidig indgå fleksibelt i fællesskabet
  • Møder børn, forældre og kolleger med glæde, mildhed og empati
  • Har blik for børnenes behov og mod på løbende at justere praksis til gavn for fællesskabet

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så håber vi, du har lyst til at blive en del af Børnehuset Grundtvigsvej og være med til at skabe stærke børnefællesskaber, udviklende læringsmiljøer og gode sproglige muligheder for alle børn.

Ansættelsesdatoen er vi fleksible omkring – for den helt rigtige pædagog til vores hus finder vi gerne den rette startdato.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Katrine Damsgaard Andersen på telefon.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.
 
Ansøgningsfrist:  30-09-2026

  
Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!
