jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Web Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Web Infrastructure team builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients, including client architecture, performance, reliability, and shared design systems.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the team through the evolution from Notion Clients. You’ll set strategy, develop senior engineers and managers, and partner across Notion to make the product faster, more reliable, and easier to build.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You'll build and manage a diverse and inclusive team of engineers and managers working on core parts of Notion's architecture. You'll create a healthy environment in your team that embodies Notion's values.

 - You'll recruit, coach, and develop engineers. You'll ensure engineers are regularly receiving feedback and making progress on personal and professional goals.

 - You'll facilitate planning—the prioritization, sequencing, and staffing of work—for your team.

 - You'll be responsible for maintaining a high-quality bar for everything your team ships.

 - You'll own execution in your team to develop a steady cadence of delivering value to your users.

 - You'll work with others to shape how Notion's engineering organization works. You'll help develop our technical practices, recruiting and onboarding strategy, planning and prioritization process, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You have managed senior engineering teams and managers, and have experience in scaling teams.

 - You have built, or are committed to building, diverse and inclusive teams.

 - You create team environments that are at once collaborative, empowering, supportive, and challenging—ones where engineers do their best work.

 - You have a sufficiently deep background in product and technology that you can ask the right questions of your team, balance product, tech, and people concerns, and make hard tradeoffs.

 - You think rigorously. You're prepared to tackle the toughest technical problems, understand trade-offs, and enable teams to make decisions and progress.

 - You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and change, especially around organizational structure and the boundaries of your role. You enjoy jumping into whatever areas need attention and learning as-you-go.

 - You value empathetic and direct communication, particularly when giving and receiving feedback.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have managed engineering teams at startups before, particularly during periods of rapid growth and organizational change.

 - You have experience rolling out engineering and management practices and processes—e.g., code review, performance reviews, and levels and ladders—where they didn't exist before.

 - You've managed teams that are across multiple offices.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 - $300,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Cuisinier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Senior Shopify Developer & Platformansvarlig
jobs.description:
Vil du tage teknisk ansvar for vores Shopify-platforme og samtidig selv være hands-on i udviklingen?

Så skal du læse med her!

Vi søger en erfaren Shopify Plus udvikler til rollen som Senior Shopify Developer & Platformansvarlig, hvor du både bliver hands-on i koden og får et centralt teknisk ansvar. Du kommer til at løse komplekse problemer, bygge solide og skalerbare løsninger og få stor indflydelse på, hvordan vi videreudvikler vores e-commerce-platforme, tekniske standarder og løsninger på tværs af vores forretning.

Om GrejFreak.dk

GrejFreak.dk er Danmarks førende onlineforhandler af outdoor-, jagt- og militærudstyr. Vi leverer grej til både friluftsfolk, professionelle og helt almindelige danskere, der sætter pris på godt udstyr. Salget sker primært gennem GrejFreak.dk, men vi driver også andre webshops i Danmark og på internationale markeder.

Vi er en ambitiøs vækstvirksomhed med fokus på innovation, samarbejde og høj faglighed. Her er der plads til gode idéer, og vi lægger vægt på, at de hurtigt kan omsættes til handling.

Vores e-commerce-forretning er i vækst, og vi har mange spændende digitale initiativer foran os. Derfor ønsker vi at styrke vores interne tekniske kompetencer med en erfaren Shopify-specialist.

Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Bidrage til den tekniske opbygning af nye shops, markeder og digitale koncepter, herunder GrejFreak.dk, GearFreak.de, ReadyBox.dk samt nye webshops til vores private label brands.

  • Arbejde med integrationer mellem Shopify og øvrige forretnings- og marketingplatforme.

  • Sikre en struktureret udviklingsproces med versionsstyring, test, kvalitetssikring og dokumentation.

  • Udvikle interne værktøjer, automatiseringer og AI-understøttede løsninger, der kan effektivisere arbejdsgange og gøre hverdagen lettere for kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

  • Fejlfinde og optimere eksisterende løsninger.

  • Vurdere tekniske løsningsmuligheder og rådgive om, hvornår noget bør udvikles, løses med standardfunktionalitet eller via tredjepartsløsninger.

  • Samarbejde med og kvalitetssikre leverancer fra eksterne udviklingspartnere.

  • Bidrage til fælles tekniske standarder og en robust, vedligeholdelsesvenlig platform.

Du bliver samtidig teknisk platformansvarlig og får en vigtig rolle i at skabe fælles tekniske standarder på tværs af vores webshops.

Det indebærer blandt andet ansvar for:

  • Sikre fælles tekniske standarder og en struktureret udviklingsproces.

  • Bidrage til en stabil, skalerbar og vedligeholdelsesvenlig Shopify-platform.

  • Dokumentere væsentlige tekniske løsninger og ændringer.

  • Vurdere tekniske risici og sikre robuste løsninger på tværs af vores webshops.

  • Sikre, at platformen og den tekniske viden er godt forankret internt.

Teknisk sparringspartner

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens øvrige teams og omsætte forretningsbehov til gode tekniske løsninger.

Vi forventer, at du kan rådgive om den bedste tekniske tilgang, udfordre unødigt komplekse løsninger og tænke i kvalitet, genbrugelighed og langsigtet vedligeholdelse.

Du skal med andre ord ikke blot implementere krav, men aktivt bidrage med teknisk sparring og foreslå den bedste vej frem.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har solid professionel erfaring med Shopify Plus og udvikling af skræddersyede Shopify-løsninger.

  • Har stærke kompetencer i Shopify Liquid samt HTML, CSS og JavaScript.

  • Har erfaring med theme development, custom komponenter og moderne udviklingsværktøjer.

  • Har arbejdet med API’er, integrationer og tekniske løsninger på tværs af systemer.

  • Har god forståelse for performance, tracking og de tekniske krav til en moderne e-commerce-platform.

  • Arbejder struktureret med kode, versionsstyring, test og dokumentation.

  • Kan fejlfinde systematisk og tage ansvar for løsninger fra idé til drift.

  • Har blik for, hvornår en løsning bør bygges, tilpasses eller løses med eksisterende funktionalitet.

  • Kan formidle tekniske problemstillinger klart til kolleger uden teknisk baggrund.

  • Tør udfordre løsninger fagligt og foreslå bedre eller mere enkle alternativer.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og trives samtidig med tæt samarbejde på tværs af virksomheden.

Erfaring med TypeScript, internationale Shopify-setups, A/B-testing og relevante e-commerce- eller marketingintegrationer er en fordel.

Det vigtigste er, at du er en erfaren Shopify-udvikler, som kan tage et reelt teknisk ejerskab og bidrage aktivt til den videre udvikling af vores platforme.

Vi tilbyder

Bliv en nøglespiller i vores globale vækst


Key Account Manager til strategisk kundeansvar hos Kallesoe Machinery A/S


Har du en stærk kommerciel og teknisk profil – og trives du med at eje dit eget marked? Er du vant til at navigere i komplekse, kundetilpassede løsninger og opbygge langsigtede relationer på beslutningstagerniveau?

Hos Kallesoe Machinery A/S bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor innovation, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd. Vores anlæg er unikke og skræddersyet til komplekse kundebehov, og som Key Account Manager får du det fulde ansvar for at udvikle og fastholde relationerne til dine nøglekunder.

Du får en grundig introduktionsperiode, hvor du opbygger solid indsigt i vores produkter, kunder og interne processer, så du står stærkt rustet, når du overtager ansvaret for dine egne nøglekunder.

Dine opgaver omfatter bl.a.:

  • Rådgivning af kunden gennem hele salgsprocessen – fra teknisk afklaring til den endelige beslutning – er en central del af tilgangen, hvor din faglige sparring skaber tillid og reel værdi
  • Udvikling og forhandling af komplekse, kundespecifikke tilbud med fokus på kundeværdi, ROI og langsigtede partnerskaber

Du bygger bro mellem teknik og strategisk salg – og bliver den stemme, kunder og kolleger søger, når kompleksiteten stiger.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en teknisk uddannelse, fx maskiningeniør, maskinmester eller tilsvarende

Kallesoe Machinery A/S er en moderne, innovativ og højteknologisk virksomhed med base i Lem ved Ringkøbing. Vi udvikler og producerer avancerede systemløsninger til den bæredygtige byggeindustri i træ – og bidrager aktivt til en grønnere og mere ressourceeffektiv byggebranche globalt. Kallesoe er en del af den tyske HOMAG Group, som indgår i Dürr-koncernen. Hos os kombinerer vi global styrke med lokal forankring. Samarbejde er ikke bare et værktøj – det er en kultur. jobs.title: Course Director UX UI and AI
jobs.description:
You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the peopleÂ whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

jobs.title: Systemadministrator til udvikling og drift af robuste integrationer
jobs.description:
Kan du få systemer, data og forretningsbehov til at hænge sammen? Har du stærke kompetencer i PowerShell, blik for API'er og lyst til at skabe robuste integrationer i et miljø, hvor Microsoft-teknologier fylder meget? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Team IT i Digital og Analyse.

Vi søger en ny kollega, som sammen med resten af teamet vil sikre, at vores systemer kan udveksle data og integreres gennem relevante grænseflader. Du får en central rolle i at skabe overblik over, hvilke data der findes i de enkelte systemer, og i at vurdere, hvordan data kan anvendes sikkert og meningsfuldt på tværs af organisationen, samtidig med de altid er opdaterede.

Din profil
Vi søger dig, der arbejder struktureret og nøjagtigt med integrationer og har både teknisk nysgerrighed og forståelse for data. Du kan sætte dig ind i komplekse systemlandskaber, omsætte behov til holdbare løsninger og dokumentere dit arbejde, så også kollegerne i driften kan medvirke til høj oppetid.

Samtidig formår du at udnytte AI som udviklingsværktøj og støtte til hurtigt at afprøve idéer og nye integrationer - uden at gå på kompromis med kvalitet, sikkerhed og grundig validering. Du tager ansvar, følger opgaverne helt til dørs og trives med at løse opgaver i tæt samarbejde med kolleger i både Team IT og resten af afdelingen.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:
  • har stærke kompetencer i PowerShell og erfaring med at udvikle, vedligeholde og fejlfinde scripts
  • har erfaring med systemintegrationer og anvendelse af API'er
  • kan skabe overblik over datakilder, datamodeller og dataflows på tværs af systemer
  • som minimum har kendskab til C#, men også gerne andre programmeringssprog og -værktøjer
  • arbejder nøjagtigt og systematisk med dokumentation, versionsstyring, test og driftsstabilitet
  • kan anvende AI til hurtigt at udvikle og teste idéer til scripts og integrationer og samtidig forholde dig kritisk til resultatet
  • har blik for, hvordan scripts og integrationer skal overvåges, dokumenteres og indrettes, så systemadministratorerne kan drifte dem sikkert og effektivt i hverdagen
  • kan samarbejde med både tekniske specialister og kolleger med fokus på data og forretning.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med SQL, Microsoft Fabric eller SharePoint - herunder særligt integrationer til disse. Kendskab til identitets- og adgangsstyring (IDM) samt Microsofts øvrige cloud- og platformsteknologier vil også være relevant.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Din vigtigste opgave bliver at udvikle og vedligeholde sammenhængen mellem Absalons systemer og data. Du bliver en central teknisk sparringspartner, når nye integrationer skal designes, eksisterende integrationer skal forbedres, og data skal stilles til rådighed for nye formål.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:
  • udvikle, vedligeholde og overvåge integrationer mellem Absalons systemer via relevante API'er
  • have et særligt ansvar for drift og videreudvikling af vores IDM-løsning, som primært er bygget op omkring en række PowerShell-scripts
  • kortlægge, dokumentere og vedligeholde overblik over data i de enkelte systemer
  • medvirke til automatisering af en del af vores driftsopgaver
  • vurdere, hvordan data kan anvendes og deles på tværs af systemer med fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og stabil drift
  • samarbejde med Team Data og Analyse om at integrere data fra forskellige systemer til Microsoft Fabric
  • udvikle og vedligeholde integrationer til SharePoint, blandt andet i relation til vores ESDH-system
  • fejlfinde på dataflows, scripts og integrationer samt sikre overvågning og relevant dokumentation
  • bidrage til valg af tekniske løsninger og standarder i et miljø, der i høj grad er baseret på Microsoft-teknologier
  • dele viden og bidrage til, at løsningerne kan driftes og videreudvikles af flere i teamet.

Dine kolleger
I Digital og Analyse er vi 26 medarbejdere fordelt på 3 teams, der brænder for at lave gode digitale løsninger til hele Absalon. Vi har et bredt katalog af services og kompetencer i brugersupport, netværk, systemudvikling, projektledelse, didaktik, læringsteknologier, digitalisering, rapportering, analyser med mere.

Vi anstrenger os for at være servicemindede og kompetente partnere i alt, hvad vi laver. Vi har en uhøjtidelig omgangsform og vores lattermuskler er veltrænede. Vi nyder gerne kage, men vi har også en sund og varieret kantineordning og mulighed for at træne i vores fitnesslokale eller bare på de mange trapper, der er på campus. Vi bor på Absalons nye campus lige ved Slagelse station, og du vil få en af Slagelses bedste udsigter fra dit skrivebord.

Stillingen hører til i Team IT, hvis primære ansvarsområder er server- og netværksdrift, devicehåndtering, support, integrationer, informationssikkerhed m.v.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest den 1. november 2026
  • Afhængigt af din anciennitet og uddannelsesbaggrund vil en forventet løn ligge mellem 40.000 kr. og 50.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension. Hertil kommer der et pensionsbidrag på 16,68% eller 18,07% afhængig af din uddannelsesbaggrund.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Brian Andersen på telefon 7248 3037 eller bran@pha.dk.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/om-professionshoejskolen-absalon/ledige-stillinger/ eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 16. september 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale den 21. september og evt. 2. samtale den 25. september.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.description:
Bang's VVS is looking for one qualified and experienced plumber / plumbing installer to join our team on Lolland, Denmark.

You'll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit. Unfortunately, we're not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will carry out varied plumbing work for private customers, businesses, industry and construction projects on Lolland.

We are looking for someone who:

Is a qualified plumber with relevant vocational training
Has practical experience as a plumber
Can work independently and deliver high-quality work
Is service-minded and comfortable working with customers
Can communicate in English
Has a category B driving licence
Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

What we offer

Gross hourly wage: DKK 180-220, depending on qualifications and experience
Candidates with several years of relevant experience can expect a salary at the higher end of the range
Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Pension scheme
5 weeks of vacation
Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension
Company vehicle
Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bang's VVS

Bang's VVS is an authorised Danish plumbing and sheet metal company established in 2016.

The company works with private customers, businesses, industry, agriculture and construction projects and handles both small and large projects. Bang's VVS places strong emphasis on quality workmanship, good customer service and energy-efficient solutions.

You will join an informal workplace with good colleagues, a high degree of independence and a strong focus on quality workmanship.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application to:

rekruttering@lolland.dk

Please write "Bang's VVS" in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe's largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit https://newcomers.lolland.dk/

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

Key Responsibilities Warehouse Operations • Support the Warehouse Manager in the daily operation of the warehouse. • Ensure stock is received, stored, rotated, and managed correctly using FIFO principles. • Monitor warehouse productivity and identify opportunities for operational improvement. • Ensure customer orders are picked, checked, packed, and dispatched accurately and on time. • Maintain high standards of housekeeping, organisation, and warehouse efficiency. • Ensure all areas are operating in line with customer requirements and company standards. Deliveries & Logistics • Coordinate inbound supplier deliveries and outbound customer deliveries. • Investigate delivery discrepancies and implement corrective actions where necessary. • Coordinate the movement of raw vegetables into the preparation area. • Work closely with Production, Purchasing, and Transport teams to meet daily customer requirements and deadlines. • Ensure vehicles are loaded safely, accurately, and efficiently. • Maintain high standards of product quality, presentation, and customer specification compliance. • Minimise picking errors, product damage, and customer complaints. jobs.title: Socialpædagog søges til Børne- og ungehjem
jobs.description:
Behandlingsinstitutioner Curam søger snarest en socialpædagog til afdeling Grønnebjerg

Curams målgruppe er børn og unge mellem 14-23 år med multiple problemstillinger, herunder omsorgssvigt, udviklingstraume, tilknytningsforstyrrelser, kriminalitet og misbrug. Vi har plads til i alt 15 unge, fordelt på 3 afdelinger, ligesom vi har ansvaret for 4 unge der bor i egen bolig, alle i Skibby. Stillingen er ledig i vores afdeling Grønnebjerg i Kirke Såby, og har plads til 5 unge mellem 14-17 år.

Arbejdestiden er mellem 7.00-23.00 i et 4 ugers rul, og laves i samarbejde med de øvrige ansatte. Man skal være indstillet på at arbejde 2-4 eftermiddag/after pr uge og mindst en weekend (fredag/lørdag eller lørdag/søndag) pr. måned. Natarbejde kommer ikke på tale, da vi har faste nattevagter.

Ansøger med kendskab til arbejdet med udsatte børn og unge vil blive foretrukket, ligesom kendskab til misbrugsproblematikker og udadreagerende adfærd er en klar fordel.

Robusthed, ro, empati og mentaliseringskompetncer, er sammen med en respektfuld og anerkendende tilgang til målgruppen og dennes familie, nødvendige kompetencer.

Ansvarlighed og ordentlighed er en forudsætning, ligesom humor og samarbejdsevne er centrale elementer for den rette ansøger. 

Vi tilbyder god løn, oplæring, kurser og supervision, ligesom der er tilrettelagt en 1-årig intern efteruddannelse for den samlede personalegruppe med opstart maj 2026. Desuden vægter vi en god omgangstone, frihed under ansvar, kollegial sparring og har nogle super gode fysiske rammer, både til personalet og de unge.

Vi arbejder ud fra en tilknytningsteoretisk, systemisk narrativ og kropsorienteret tilgang.

Værdigrundlag:

  • Vi tror på, at alle børn og unge har ressourcer og styrker og alle gør det bedst de kan.

  • Vi tror på, at enhver person har ret til at blive behandlet individuelt ud fra en særligt tilrettelagt og målrettet behandlingstænkning, der tager højde for barnet/den unges livshistorie, følelsesmæssige samt kognitive forudsætninger for at kunne indgå i kontakt og relation med sin omverden.

  • Vi tror på, at professionelle, som er autentiske, træder i karakter, og som ikke er bange for at involvere sig og sætte sig selv i spil, kan gøre en forskel.

  • Vi tror på, at positive forandringer bedst skabes i et positivt defineret felt. Vi tager altid udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneske og lægger vægt på, at alle bliver mødt med en forståelse for de vanskeligheder barnet/den unge har med sig.

  • Vi tror på, at en helhedsorienteret tilgang, hvor hele netværker inddrages, er den bedste forudsætning for forandring, der også holder på længere sigt.

Kørsel i egen bil kan i nødstilfælde være nødvendigt, hvis alle Curams biler er optaget.

Med venlig hilsen

Flemming Zuschlag Christihansen

Aut. psykolog og forstander

jobs.title: True Dates Production Operator
jobs.description:
True Co. was founded in 2017 and began as an entrepreneurial journey in the founders’ kitchen, where they experimented with developing plastic-free chewing gum. The idea of revolutionizing snacking through more natural alternatives has since developed into a company that today also produces True Dates. The products are sold in more than 50 countries and the company is growing. True Co. is therefore looking for operators for newly established shifts at the True Dates factory in Glostrup at Formervangen 13. Working hours will be 21.55 to 07.10 Monday to Thursday

Your primary tasks

  • Physical production, operation, and monitoring of production and processing equipment.

  • Rotation between stations and different parts of the process is a natural part of the work.

  • Ongoing checks, measurements, and record-keeping in accordance with documented standards.

  • Troubleshooting and problem-solving in collaboration with the maintenance team.

  • Cleaning and preparation of equipment and the production area.

  • Ensuring quality and food safety.

  • Ad hoc tasks related to production, warehouse, and cleaning depending on needs.

Qualifications

  • You enjoy working in a dynamic work environment with clear production targets and requirements for tasty products, while actively contributing to maintaining high food safety standards.

  • You like working in teams where colleagues help each other to complete tasks.

  • Not a requirement but a plus if you have experience as a process operator, industrial operator, process technologist, or similar. Experience from food production or another regulated environment is an advantage.

  • You have a mechanical/technical interest.

  • You can read and understand English, as documentation, instructions, and the corporate language is English.

The work is carried out under controlled conditions, and therefore requirements apply regarding personal hygiene and mandatory clothing provided by the company.

We offer

  • Thorough training in operating machines.

  • Training in producing food according to GMP standards.

  • Competitive salary

O’Carroll Engineering is an innovative, off-site modular engineering steel fabrication specialist. Established in 1990 we combine a highly skilled workforce with technologically advanced and digital fabrication methods to produce efficient-install solutions to industrial and construction markets. Specialists in modular walkways and access systems, stairs and modular apartment balconies. O’Carroll Engineering is offering an opportunity to join our 165+ strong, highly skilled team and be a part of an innovative, technology-driven, industry-leading manufacturer. Our team members are at the core of our growth and we endeavour to strike the best possible work-life balance along with training and advancement opportunities to ensure we challenge and motivate employees. jobs.title: Mid-Market Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

 - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

 - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

 - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption
   
   


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Experience in selling technical products to technical buyers in the Mid-Market segment (500-2999 employees)

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

 - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - You can own the room—you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native or bilingual-level Korean fluency and business-level English proficiency
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion

jobs.title: Lead Estimator
jobs.description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills


If this sounds like you please APPLY reach out to Ebony Ison, ebony.ison@complexco.com.au


This role is also advertised on SEEK Lead Estimator Job in Canberra ACT - SEEK

jobs.title: Student Assistant– Cyber Security & Compliance
jobs.description:
Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/ 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant – Cyber Security & Compliance who likes to make a difference!

Job description:

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support the Infrastructure & Security team. The role will work closely with the Cyber Security and Compliance functions, helping maintain governance processes, security operations, reporting, and documentation while gaining practical experience within enterprise IT security and compliance. The position supports activities within vulnerability management, access governance, audits, and security reporting.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations Support

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Assist with endpoint compliance reviews and Intune-related administrative activities.

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Coordinate follow-up with system owners and suppliers regarding security findings.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence.

  • Support preparation for internal and external audits.

  • Maintain compliance documentation and evidence repositories.

  • Track audit findings and remediation activities.

Access Management & Governance

  • Assist with periodic access reviews.

  • Track completion of access review activities.

  • Help maintain governance processes and security controls documentation.

Documentation & Process Management

  • Update security procedures, standards, and runbooks.

  • Maintain SharePoint-based documentation repositories.

  • Ensure documents are reviewed and updated according to governance requirements.

Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within IT, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Excel, and SharePoint is an advantage.

  • Interest in cyber security, governance, risk, and compliance.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note:

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 30/09/2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

If you have any questions, please contact Patrick Frømming, Manager, Infrastructure & Security (PFN@nordic-rcc.net).

jobs.title: Sales Recruiter
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sales Recruiter you’ll help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization. You’ll recruit for new and evolving customer-facing roles—including Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, and Forward Deployed Engineers—that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner with Sales leaders and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires.

You will use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for. You will also help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build trusted partnerships with Sales leaders, advising on role definition, search strategy, assessment design, and hiring decisions for new and evolving teams.

 - Deliver high-quality hires across the next generation of GTM roles, from sourcing through close, while creating a thoughtful, inclusive, and high-touch candidate experience.

 - Translate Notion’s product love, AI opportunity, and customer motion into accurate candidate narratives that help the right people self-select in.

 - Use talent-market research, mapping, and recruiting data to improve hiring strategy and decision quality.

 - Raise the quality and consistency of the hiring system through structured intake, calibration, debriefs, manager coaching, and sourcing strategies that expand representation.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated success recruiting across GTM searches, with the judgment to learn and represent evolving role profiles accurately.

 - Ability to turn business strategy into clear candidate profiles, search plans, and objective assessment criteria—and to influence senior leaders toward strong decisions.

 - Strong sourcing, market-mapping, and closing instincts across various Sales disciplines.

 - Operational rigor and comfort using data to diagnose pipeline health, measure impact, and improve the candidate and hiring-manager experience.

 - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools: you use them to think better, improve recruiting workflows, and make your work easier for others to build on. 

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.description: Vuoi essere parte del cambiamento digitale e della trasformazione tecnologica? Hai esperienza in ambito ICT e vuoi lavorare su progetti innovativi? Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per conto di CISALFA GROUP, azienda italiana presente in Italia e in Germania con 7 società e le insegne Calafa Sport, INTERSPORT Voswinkel e SportScheck, con più di 240 negozi e 5.500 persone, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di: CYBER SECURITY ENGINEER La risorsa opererà in stretta collaborazione con il Cyber Security Architect, il SOC e i team IT, contribuendo all'implementazione, alla gestione operativa e al continuo miglioramento delle soluzioni di sicurezza aziendali. Il ruolo ha una forte componente tecnico-operativa e prevede la responsabilità diretta sull'esecuzione dei controlli di sicurezza, sul monitoraggio degli eventi e sul supporto alle attività di incident management, in ambienti sia on-premise sia cloud. jobs.description: Per importante azienda del settore impianti tecnologici, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Ingegnere/ tecnico di Processo/industrializzazione, che sarà inserito nel team dedicato allo sviluppo di progetti impiantistici di Biometano e Biogas. Il candidato si occuperà della redazione della documentazione tecnica e svolgerà attività di progettazione, dimensionamento e sviluppo di componenti, dispositivi e apparecchiature tecnologiche dell'impianto e della rete piping. Preparerà la documentazione tecnica per le richieste di offerta delle forniture delle apparecchiature, dispositivi e rete piping dell'impianto. Si occuperà della valutazione delle offerte ed il follow-up della documentazione tecnica dei fornitori, per la corretta corrispondenza delle caratteristiche che i prodotti e le apparecchiature devono possedere secondo le specifiche e le esigenze prestazionali dell'impianto. Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Director, Product Design to lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, reporting to the Co-Founder & Head of Design.

This is a true player-coach role for someone who loves building products as much as leading people. You'll lead and develop a talented team of product designers while remaining deeply embedded in the work itself. You'll whiteboard with designers, navigate complex product decisions.

The Co-Founder & Head of Design remains closely involved in design critique and product quality. Your role is to lead the day-to-day design organization by creating the structure, alignment, and momentum that enable exceptional work. You'll stay two to three layers deeper than the Co-Founder & Head of Design on active initiatives, surfacing the context, tradeoffs, and insights needed to make thoughtful decisions without requiring constant immersion in every project.

Success in this role requires exceptional product judgment, strong design taste, technical fluency, and a collaborative approach. You're someone who naturally connects disciplines, elevates the people around you, and makes both the work and the team better every day.

 
 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, ensuring work is aligned, prioritized, and delivered to an exceptionally high standard.

 - Manage, mentor, and develop a team of product designers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and impact.

 - Shape and elevate the customer journey

 - Work alongside designers every day by whiteboarding ideas, exploring alternatives, reviewing work in progress, and solving complex product and interaction challenges.

 - Stay deeply informed across active initiatives, surfacing the context and insights that enable the Co-Founder & Head of Design to engage quickly in meaningful design critique and high-impact product decisions.

 - Raise the quality of product design through thoughtful feedback, exceptional craft, and strong design taste.

 - Help evolve Replit's design practices, workflows, and team culture while preserving the speed and flexibility of a high-growth company.

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard exceptional product design talent as the organization grows.

 
 


WHO YOU ARE

You're a builder first and a manager second.

You enjoy being close to the work, helping designers think through difficult problems, and making good teams even better. You're equally comfortable sketching ideas on a whiteboard, giving thoughtful design feedback, coaching a designer through a difficult challenge, or partnering with engineering on implementation details.

You combine exceptional product judgment with strong design taste and technical fluency. You're collaborative, humble, curious, and energized by helping great work happen.

 
 


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience leading product design teams within high-growth technology companies.

 - Proven ability to balance people leadership with meaningful hands-on product design contribution.

 - A portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft, interaction design, product thinking, and systems thinking.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver technically sophisticated products.

 - Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development in fast-moving environments.

 - Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Strong design taste, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Experience simplifying complex technical products into elegant, approachable user experiences.

 
 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing developer tools, technical products, or software creation platforms.

 - Experience building AI-powered products or AI-native workflows.

 - Coding experience or strong technical curiosity.

 - Experience growing design teams in startup or scale-up environments.

 - Active use of AI throughout your design process.

 
 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This isn't a traditional design leadership role.

We're looking for someone who thrives in the work, not above it. Someone who enjoys solving problems alongside designers, building strong partnerships across Product and Engineering, and bringing the depth of context that allows the Co-Founder & Head of Design to focus on the moments where their perspective has the greatest impact.

This is a role for someone who is excited by complex product challenges, passionate about developing exceptional designers, and motivated by building products that make powerful technology feel intuitive.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

Töö asukoht Valga maakonnas Valga vallas (tööandja pakub majutust, hüvitab transpordikulud).

Tööülesanded: MTÜ Valga Abikeskus avab uue üksuse, kus pakutakse ööpäevaringset erihoolekandeteenust autismispektrihäirega inimestele.
Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Tööülesannete täitmine eeldab head füüsilist vormi ja aktiivset kaasamõtlemist teenuse arendamisel ning loomulikult kliente toetavat hoiakut.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Tööle asumisel kontrollitakse alati karistusregistri väljavõtet.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: öösiti
