ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for an experienced, creative, and rigorous brand campaign expert who excels at conceptualizing innovative campaign strategies and bringing clarity to complex challenges.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Manager, Brand brings Notion’s mission, product capabilities, and customer stories to life through targeted, insight-driven brand campaigns. This role is responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and executing integrated marketing programs that connect Notion’s core value props to the needs and aspirations of our customers—from individuals to global enterprises.

Reporting to the Campaign Lead, you’ll drive seasonal campaigns, brand activations, and special projects that aim to build excitement among both current customers and prospects. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative to transform feature launches, product education, and customer insights into powerful, scalable brand moments that build understanding, drive conversion, and reinforce Notion’s position as the AI workspace for teams. Responsibilities include:

 - Lead cross-functional campaign execution, from concept to delivery, for both special brand projects and feature-led programs

 - Partner with Creative to generate out-of-the-box brand marketing concepts, breaking from the industry mold and encouraging blue sky thinking

 - Partner with Product Marketing to develop strategies that translate product value into meaningful narratives for the target audience of each activation or campaign

 - Partner with Growth Marketing to define the right mix of content, media, and channels to reach each segment effectively

 - Manage campaign briefs, creative deliverables, and timelines—ensuring clarity, accountability, and alignment across stakeholders

 - Integrate brand and performance media buying from planning through delivery and reporting

 - Define and track KPIs for each campaign, analyzing and sharing results and applying insights to optimize future programs

 - Ensure all campaigns maintain a cohesive Notion voice and brand expression, while adapting to audience needs and regional contexts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with proven success leading complex projects to fruition

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with new AI tools, and are passionate about staying on top of fast-moving industry trends

 - Speed: You bias towards action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - GTM expert: You have strong understanding of and passion for go-to-market planning, messaging, and storytelling for brand-driven campaigns

 - Collaborative: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you, across product, creative, and data teams

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to balance multiple work streams and deadlines at once while iterating for improvement




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting

 - Experience supporting global and/or regionalized campaigns

 - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is the fastest way to turn ideas into software. With our powerful AI-powered Agent and Assistant, anyone can create and launch apps from natural language in just one click. Build and deploy full-stack applications directly from your browser—no setup required. Never written a line of code in your life? No problem. Replit makes software creation accessible, collaborative, and lightning-fast. Join us in our mission to empower the next generation of builders.

We are seeking a Strategic Finance professional to join Replit's growing team in Foster City, CA. In this critical role, you'll work in a lean team supporting high-impact strategic and operational initiatives across the business to drive data-driven decision making. You’ll partner directly with executive leadership and the Board to align financial strategies with our ambitious growth objectives. This role reports to the Head of Finance.




ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

You'll contribute to critical projects across three main core areas:

Internal Strategic & Operational Initiatives

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to build financial models and analyses that drive organizational decision-making

 - New product launches: Build and present financial models, business cases, and investment analyses for new product launches

 - GTM Finance: Partner with go-to-market leadership to drive growth through sales capacity planning, funnel and pipeline analytics, pricing strategy and resource allocation

 - Pricing & Packaging: Analyze pricing and packaging strategies using quantitative and qualitative frameworks to recommend optimal approaches

 - Unit Economics: Recommend strategies that balance growth investments with operational efficiency to achieve long-term margin targets

 - International Growth: Analyze global expansion opportunities including localization, regional pricing strategies, go-to-market approaches, and commercial partnerships

 - Enterprise Sales: Partner with sales leadership to scale enterprise sales operations and strategy

Corporate Strategy & Planning

 - Long-Range Planning: Collaborate with FP&A team on forecasting, financial planning, long-range planning, growth headcount planning, and overall financial strategy

 - Board Reporting: Assist in preparing quarterly board materials and presentations

 - Market Insights: Conduct competitive analysis and industry research to inform strategic planning

Corporate Development & Investor Relations

 - Corporate Development: Support corporate development initiatives including M&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships from initial sourcing through execution and integration

 - Investor Relations & Fundraising: Support investor relations activities including fundraising, investor communications, and preparation of materials for investors



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3-6 years in investment banking, private equity, consulting, business operations, and/or strategic finance

 - Experience with SQL, Python, or other data analysis tools

 - An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

 - Self-directed with a strong work ethic and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

 - Expert-level financial modeling skills and proficiency with business intelligence tools

 - Strong presence and communication skills

 - Exceptional business judgment with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable strategic insights

Join Replit and help shape the financial future of a platform that's revolutionizing how people learn, build, and deploy software with AI.




BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience in strategic finance or related field at a scaling technology company

 - Current Replit user

 - Background in AI or enterprise technology companies

 - Understanding of compute and infrastructure costs in tech environments


This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • istraživati tržište i pronalaziti građevinske tvrtke koje odgovaraju našoj ciljanoj skupini
  • sastavljati i redovito ažurirati popise potencijalnih korisnika
  • pronalaziti vlasnike, direktore i druge osobe odgovorne za donošenje odluka
  • istraživati osnovne podatke o tvrtki prije prvog kontakta
  • kontaktirati potencijalne korisnike putem e-maila i telefona
  • predstaviti razlog javljanja i provjeriti postoji li interes za razgovor
  • voditi komunikaciju od prvog kontakta do dogovaranja prodajne prezentacije
  • zakazivati termine i pripremati prodaji informacije o potencijalnom korisniku
  • voditi urednu evidenciju svih kontakata i aktivnosti u HubSpotu
  • pratiti dogovorene rokove i planirati ponovne kontakte
  • pripremati i slati ponude, ugovore i fakture prema postojećim predlošcima
  • surađivati s prodajom i osobom zaduženom za odnose s korisnicima
  • na početku ćete upoznati Insidico, postojeće korisnike i probleme koje aplikacija rješava
  • proći ćete naš način pronalaska potencijalnih korisnika, primjere dosadašnjih e-mailova i poziva, pravila rada u hubspotu te način na koji se dogovorena prezentacija predaje prodaji
  • prve popise kontakata, e-mailove i pozive prolazit ćemo zajedno. Cilj je da nakon razdoblja uhodavanja možete samostalno organizirati svoj rad i voditi pretprodajne aktivnosti
  • opseg aktivnosti i očekivani rezultati prilagođavat će se dogovorenom broju radnih sati
Poslodavac traži:
  • tražimo osobu koja zna jasno komunicirati, dobro organizirati svoj rad i samostalno doći do potrebnih informacija
  • važno nam je da nemate problem nazvati osobu s kojom prethodno niste razgovarali.U ovom poslu bit će neodgovorenih e-mailova, odbijenih poziva i odgovora da tvrtka trenutačno nije zainteresirana. Očekujemo da takve situacije prihvatite kao normalan dio prodajnog procesa i nastavite raditi bez nepotrebnog pritiska na potencijalnog korisnika.
  • prethodno iskustvo u prodaji nije uvjet. Spremni smo raditi i s osobom koja tek ulazi u prodaju, ali očekujemo interes za učenje, samostalnost i odgovornost prema dogovorenim zadacima.
Uvjeti:
  • najmanje završena srednja škola
  • razvijene usmene i pisane komunikacijske vještine
  • organiziranost i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • samostalnost, upornost i snalažljivost
  • urednost u vođenju podataka i praćenju rokova
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • korištenje programa Microsoft Office i Outlook
  • spremnost na rad u HubSpotu, Google kalendaru, Google Meetu i internim alatima
  • aktivno znanje hrvatskog jezika
  • B2B prodaji ili telefonskom kontaktiranju potencijalnih korisnika
  • istraživanju tržišta i izradi baza kontakata
  • radu u CRM sustavu, posebno HubSpotu
  • građevinskoj industriji
  • prodaji softvera ili drugih poslovnih usluga
Poslodavac nudi:
  • rad na nepuno radno vrijeme uz mogućnost kasnijeg prelaska na puno radno vrijeme
  • mogućnost rada putem ugovora o radu ili studentskog ugovora
  • fleksibilan raspored unutar unaprijed dogovorenog broja sati
  • rad iz našeg ureda u Osijeku
  • mogućnost djelomičnog rada od kuće nakon razdoblja uhodavanja
  • dogovoreni sustav nagrađivanja prema rezultatima
  • rad u malom timu u kojem ćete izravno surađivati s prodajom i Customer Successom
  • detaljan onboarding i podršku tijekom prvih mjeseci
  • mogućnost napredovanja prema samostalnom vođenju prodajnih prezentacija i prodajnih procesa
Postupak odabira: Kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor bit će pozvani na razgovor i praktično testiranje. Testiranje će uključivati zadatke povezane s istraživanjem potencijalnih korisnika, pisanom komunikacijom, organizacijom rada i kratkom simulacijom telefonskog razgovora. Ne očekujemo da prije razgovora poznajete sve funkcionalnosti Insidica. Zanima nas kako razmišljate, pronalazite informacije, komunicirate i organizirate zadatke. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



TEAM

Brand & Creative defines how Replit shows up in the world and leads the creative work that brings it to market. On the Brand side, the function sets company-level direction: defining the brand, shaping the narrative, and establishing how Replit is understood and expressed in the market. On the Creative side, the function leads the planning, development, and execution of creative work across campaigns, launches, events, and major company initiatives; translating strategy into high-quality outputs across every touchpoint. Brand & Creative ensures that what Replit is and what Replit makes remain aligned. Resulting in a clear, consistent, and differentiated brand experience across the company.




ROLE

The Brand Designer is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining the Replit brand system. The role focuses on core brand foundations and their application across key surfaces, including product and marketing. In partnership with internal and external partners, this role ensures the brand is clear, consistent, and scalable across all touchpoints. This role reports to the Brand & Creative Lead.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and evolve the Replit visual brand system

 - Design and maintain core brand assets, guidelines, and documentation

 - Apply the brand system across key surfaces including product, web, and primary marketing channels

 - Partner with Product and Design to ensure consistent brand expression within the product experience

 - Provide guidance and feedback to internal teams and external partners on brand usage

 - Partner with external design studios and agencies to develop and extend the brand system

 - Review and direct external work to ensure alignment with brand standards

 - Ensure consistency and quality across all brand-critical touchpoints

 - Develop scalable design frameworks that support long-term brand growth

 - Contribute hands-on design work on high-visibility and foundational projects




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5-7+ years of experience in brand design, visual systems, or identity design

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating brand systems, identity work, and application across multiple touchpoints

 - Expertise in typography, layout, and visual systems

 - Experience building and maintaining design systems at scale

 - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

 - Ability to balance conceptual thinking with executional rigor

 - Experience working with external agencies or design partners

 - Strong attention to detail and consistency

 - Experience collaborating with Product and cross-functional teams



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, MEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Arabic.




NICE TO HAVES:

 -  Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Everybody in the company is rewarded with a share of profit each December—we succeed together.

Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

Responsibilities

 

  • Help prospects find the specific value they seek (this is the product you are looking for)
  • Collaborate with our diverse international team to push us on the leading edge of our fields
  • Learn to be a product expert and confidently answer product questions from prospects
  • Discover how to be an expert in SaaS for recognition programs
  • Master our sales technology stack
  • Support the complete sales cycle, from qualified lead to close
  • Skillfully navigate consultative sales discussions and live demos

Essentials

 

  • Applications are open to all experience levels, with a minimum of 1 year proven success in SaaS sales or a similar role
  • Must live in Europe
  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)
  • Loads of energy, humour, passion, and empathy
  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills
  • Commitment to continuous improvement
  • You have access to fast, reliable internet and a dedicated space to work without distractions
  • Meet and exceed measurable performance goals to succeed and progress in this role

What we offer

Work-life balance

  • 38 hour work week, Monday to Friday (your weekends are yours)
  • 20 days paid annual leave
  • 20 days paid parental leave (available after one year)
  • 12 days paid public holidays (your local country/region public holidays)
  • Your birthday is a holiday every year

Personal development and wellbeing

  • Commitment to continued learning and development
  • A culture of promoting work life balance
  • Access to mental health support

Location and compensation

  • Full-time role, based remotely, work anywhere within Europe
  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location
  • Budget for computer and office equipment (pending 6 month probationary period)

 

Respect, growth and stability

  • Friendly, sociable, responsible, collaborative team (a great place to be)
  • Respect for each other’s time, value and contribution
  • Regular communication with global team via chat and video calls
  • Dynamic, young, growing tech company leveraging all the latest tech tools and leading industry trends
  • Stable, bootstrapped, independent business (no VCs calling the shots)

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer, you’ll take emerging ideas from concept to polished experiences. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products.




The Goal: Build products that can define major new categories for Replit. You will combine the flexibility of software with the accessibility of presentations, spreadsheets, dashboards, and visual editors, enabling anyone to create powerful, interactive artifacts through natural language.




The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators, knowledge workers, and high-leverage teams. Our users should be able to turn an idea, dataset, or business problem into a polished, editable, and shareable product just by themselves.

Candidates who thrive here often have the product judgment, technical range, and ownership mindset associated with founders. This is a high-visibility role working closely with product leadership.





HOW WE WORK

Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders, not narrowly specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous teams built for velocity and technical leverage. Engineers maintain meaningful ownership over technical direction, product quality, and launch success, supported by Product and Design partners.



Cadence: We work in focused three-week sprints, shipping quickly, observing real user behavior, and incorporating feedback into each iteration. We value decisive execution, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to make progress without perfectly defined requirements.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own major product experiences from initial concept through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and continued improvement

 - Invent and build intuitive interfaces for generating, editing, arranging, and collaborating on AI-created presentations, data applications, and visual artifacts

 - Deliver exceptional frontend experiences across interaction design, typography, layout, motion, accessibility, performance, and error recovery

 - Partner directly with users, Product, Design, and AI engineers to understand real workflows, test ideas, and turn feedback into better products

 - Create reusable editing, visualization, and collaboration primitives that accelerate future products across Replit
   
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of shipping high-quality, user-facing products

 - Understanding of the full agentic software development stack, helping coding agents build, test and review correct code

 - Deep experience with TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, along with strong knowledge of browser performance, application state, responsive design, and accessibility

 - Strong product judgment and visual taste, with the ability to balance usability, speed, correctness, polish, and long-term maintainability

 - Comfort working across the full stack, including Node.js, APIs, Postgres, data models, and production debugging

 - Familiarity with agentic software development and how coding agents build, test, review, and operate software
   
   
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Building visual editors, presentation software, creative tools, data applications, developer tools, or collaboration products

 - Working with canvas or graphics systems, rich text, direct manipulation, real-time collaboration, data visualization, or complex interactive interfaces

 - Designing user experiences around AI generation, streaming responses, tool calls, and long-running agent workflows

 - Founding a technical company, working as a founding engineer, or shipping a high-visibility independent project

These experiences are preferred, but not required. We care most about what you have built, the quality of your product thinking, and your ability to learn quickly.





EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Building on top of our Replit Slides AI-native presentation product where users can generate beautiful decks, directly edit elements, collaborate with others, and reliably export their work

 - Enable Replit Agent to turn raw datasets and natural-language questions into interactive, trustworthy data applications

 - Design visual tools that make AI-generated work feel as precise, editable, and controllable as traditionally authored content

 - Build reusable editing, visualization, collaboration, and artifact-management systems that power multiple new Replit products

 - Develop feedback loops and evaluations that improve the visual quality of Agent-generated artifacts
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications

  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. Experience & interest in vibe coding and/or technical experience is highly valued.

This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your expertise to build a world-class BDR organization that effectively cuts through the noise to communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives

 - Coach and mentor BDRs on qualification methodology, objection handling, and pipeline generation techniques

 - Uphold CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy across the SDR organization

 - Stay current on industry trends and competitive landscape to inform team strategy

 - Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

 - Experience with CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot/SFDC, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead, Outreach, Default, etc)

 - Passion for technology and ability to quickly learn and teach complex technical concepts

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:



1) Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

2) Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

3) People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

4) People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1) Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

2) Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.

 - Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.

3) Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.

4) Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




HOW YOU’LL WORK

 - Embedded, not independent: You will work as an extension of strategic People Partner leaders and existing Talent Management team, not as a separate talent silo.

 - Strategic + practical: You can shape philosophy at 10,000 feet and turn it into an executable V1 strategy in a week – not for the purpose of moving fast, but for getting opinions and engagement of the right solution fast.

 - High taste, low ego: You have strong opinions about what great talent work looks like, but you build through partnership and field feedback.

 - Systems-minded: You design for repeatability and leverage, while knowing when to do the unscalable thing first.

 - Business-first: You anchor talent work in company outcomes, not HR activity.

 - AI-native and Notion-powered: You are energized by reimagining how talent work should change when AI can remove manual coordination and amplify judgment. You also understand how Notion can support our initiatives.

 - Path-agnostic: You’re glad to start as an individual contributor and build the case for a team through impact, not title.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.

This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Maintain accurate customer and forecasting data in Replit’s CRM (Hubspot)

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing collaboration and support

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in AE or SE/technical sales role, preferably in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 3+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - You are a fluent Russian speaker

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.




This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.




This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.




This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

 - Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

 - Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

 - Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

 - Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

 - Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

 - Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

 - Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

 - Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

 - Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

 - Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

 - Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

 - A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

 - Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

 - Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

 - Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building account-based marketing programs.

 - Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

 - Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.




WHY THIS ROLE

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.



The playbook for B2B demand generation is changing. Buyers expect better content and experiences, AI is reshaping how programs get built, and old attribution models are under pressure. If you want to apply what already works, challenge what doesn’t, and help define a more modern model, this is the job.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $245,000 – $275,000 per year.

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.



This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.



You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.



The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Written and spoken Japanese fluency to communicate directly with external customers, partners, and internal teams




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

 - Business level English proficiency to communicate effectively with global stakeholders and peers.

 - Experience working with Japanese enterprise customers or familiarity with Japan market dynamics and business practices.

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is growing quickly, and our Corporate Services needs are becoming more complex. We're looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager, Corporate Services to define sourcing strategies, guide supplier decisions, and build long-term partnerships across critical areas of the business.

In this role, you'll partner closely with Finance, Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, Compliance, HR, and Facilities to develop sourcing strategies, negotiate commercial terms, manage supplier performance, and help teams make informed decisions across value, cost, quality, speed, and risk.

You'll be a strategic advisor to leaders across the business, bringing market intelligence, commercial expertise, and supplier insights to help teams make thoughtful investment decisions and maximize the value of their vendor partnerships.

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Deliver measurable value, savings, and cost avoidance across Corporate Services spend, including Finance & Accounting, Contingent Workforce, Facilities, Benefits, HR Services, Travel, and related categories, helping fund new initiatives while protecting service quality.

 - Build strategic procurement plans with business partners, translating business needs into clear sourcing strategies, negotiation plans, and execution roadmaps.

 - Shape category strategy and stakeholder roadmaps by bringing market intelligence, supplier insights, and total-cost-of-ownership thinking into planning conversations.

 - Operate as an extension of stakeholder teams by aligning on priorities, enabling clear decisions, and driving fast execution while maximizing value.

 - Partner closely with Legal and Finance to structure deals that deliver clear commercial terms, budget visibility, and measurable business value.

 - Reduce risk across our vendor portfolio by strengthening contract coverage, supplier governance, and performance management routines.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in indirect procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, or a related field.

 - 3+ years owning Corporate Services categories such as Finance & Accounting, Contingent Workforce, Facilities / Real Estate, Benefits, HR Services, Travel, and related Corporate Services categories.

 - Experience leading complex sourcing events end to end, including RFx, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.

 - Strong business judgment and analytical rigor, including spend analysis, benchmarking, business case development, and savings / cost avoidance measurement.

 - Deep understanding of source-to-contract and procure-to-pay practices, with the ability to guide teams through intake, approvals, vendor onboarding, POs, and contract handoffs without slowing the business down.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership with teams such as Legal, Finance, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, and Compliance, including managing / negotiating commercial and legal terms and a track record of reducing risk while delivering value.

 - Experience operating in a highly collaborative environment where influence, relationship-building, and business partnership are as important as procurement expertise.

 - Familiarity negotiating software / SaaS agreements that support HR, Benefits, Marketing, or Finance functions, including license models, usage-based pricing, and consumption / credits.

 - Experience advising stakeholders on category strategy, supplier tradeoffs, and budget planning.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $170,000 - $190,000 per year.
